Mission 

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne. 

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités 

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.

Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.

Vos responsabilités : 

- Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.

- Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.

- Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.

- Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.

- Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.

- Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.

- Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.

Profil recherché 

Les indispensables : 

- Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.

- Votre code est testé et maintenable.

- Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

- La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.

- Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.

- Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.

Un plus, pas un prérequis : 

- Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.

- Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.

- Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.

- Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.

- Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement 

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 60 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité + jusqu’à 6 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Senior AI Builder - Paris
description:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle. 

Et tout commence par vous. 

Mission 

En tant que Senior AI Builder, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients. **Vous transmettez et construisez : vous pilotez des initiatives de montée en compétences, concevez avec les métiers des agents et solutions IA qui répondent à leurs besoins, et accompagnez leur adoption. Vous coachez les consultants juniors et êtes responsable de la qualité et des résultats de vos travaux. 

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. **Vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide** : vous concevez et animez des expériences d’apprentissage qui donnent envie de passer à l’action, construisez des agents et des solutions fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et les faites évoluer au contact de leurs utilisateurs pour ancrer de nouveaux usages. 

Au plus près des métiers, vous identifiez les opportunités de repenser les tâches, faire évoluer les rôles et responsabilités, et réinventer les façons de travailler avec l’IA. Vous faites le lien entre les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) et les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), aux côtés de nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre réussite se mesure à l’adoption réelle des solutions, à l’autonomie des équipes et aux changements concrets dans leur quotidien. 

Activités & Responsabilités 

I. Analyse & Cadrage 

Animer des ateliers avec les métiers et le L&D pour analyser les besoins, segmenter les publics et cartographier un workflow. Proposer la solution cible, le rôle de l’humain et de l’agent, les contrôles nécessaires et les critères d’acceptation. Concevoir le séquencement d’un module ou d’un parcours, avec cas d’usage, temps de pratique et modalités d’évaluation. 

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions 

Créer des ateliers et playbooks contextualisés, prototyper des assistants ou agents simples en amont et en direct avec les participants, à l'aide de plateformes approuvées et de patterns réutilisables.Définir et exécuter jeux d'essai, tests utilisateurs et critères qualité; documenter les limites et faire valider les points sensibles.Animer de manière autonome, adapter la séance au niveau du public et coacher un Junior sur ses premières animations.Traduire une question business en KPIs, en définitions et en dashboards complets livrés en autonomie, et transformer les analyses en storyline avec un « so what » clair.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté 

Organiser office hours, challenges d'application et train-the-trainer, outiller des champions et des managers de proximité. Accompagner la mise en usage, former les référents makers et préparer les supports de transfert. Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pendant le périmètre convenu et proposer des améliorations priorisées.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change 

Suivre l'adoption et la valeur du use case, les compétences acquises, la capacité à répliquer et les premiers usages; proposer des ajustements concrets pour améliorer l'activation. Contribuer à l’analyse des freins et au plan de change du programme, sous la responsabilité du chef de mission. Identifier les dépendances SI, les risques sécurité et le besoin d'escalade vers la DSI ou AI Engineering. 

Profil recherché 

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez avoir la main sur un périmètre, structurer des problèmes complexes et voir vos recommandations se concrétiser, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre les mains du client plutôt que lui décrire une vision.

- 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en conseil, transformation digitale, data / IA ou conduite du changement, avec une première expérience de pilotage d’un stream ou d’une mission et de coaching de consultants juniors.

- Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.

- Une bonne maîtrise de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding).

- Une aisance dans la conception et l’animation d’expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, d’ateliers collaboratifs et de dispositifs de montée en compétences par la pratique.

- Une capacité à comprendre les enjeux et processus métier, à embarquer les parties prenantes et à accompagner la transformation des tâches, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.

- Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact 

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients. 

Notre accompagnement s'étend sur l'intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : Strategize AI (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opérationnels), Deploy AI (ingénierie, industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et Adopt AI (conduite du changement, acculturation, usage quotidien de l'IA). 

Envie d'en savoir plus ? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre? 

De la stratégie à la réalisation 
Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers. Une collaboration entre expertises 
Occuper un rôle à la croisée de l'humain (AI Adoption), de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (AI Engineering). Un rôle avec de l’autonomie et des perspectives
Piloter des streams, développer une expertise, faire grandir une équipe et contribuer au développement de l’activité. Un parcours clair de progression 

Un accompagnement concret : counsellor, parcours de formation et programme de leadership. 

Processus de recrutement 

- Un entretien de fit RH (30 / 45’) avec les RH / Talent Acquisition

- Un entretien de fit expert (60’) avec un AI Builder Senior ou Manager

- Une présentation d’un cas réel (60’) sur lequel le candidat a travaillé par le passé avec un Manager

- Un role play AI Adoption Senior (45 / 60’) avec Directeur

- Un entretien de fit final (30’) avec un AI Builder Partner

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement 

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

title: Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist, Post Graduate Trainee
description:
The Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist (post-grad trainee) will join the International Medical TTR team and report to International Medical Strategy & Operations. The post-grad trainee will support the planning, governance and execution of the international Medical Affairs Strategy for ATTR-CM across Alnylam's international markets, working closely with regional and country Medical teams and cross-functional partners. The role contributes to medical operations and planning deliverables, evidence generation portfolio, scientific engagement and insight programs, field medical excellence initiatives and patient experience work and offers first-hand insight into how a regional Medical Affairs organization is run. The scope is intentionally flexible: the more capability, initiative and curiosity the post-grad trainee brings, the more the remit can expand, in line with results. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Support the International Medical Strategy & Operations team in planning, tracking and reporting on International Medical TTR strategic priorities and operating-model deliverables across international markets

- Help with the preparation of management materials, such as leadership updates, pre-reads, meeting materials and executive presentations, turning complex information into clear, decision-ready outputs

- Support medical planning and budget cycles by consolidating regional and country inputs, tracking spend against plan and preparing summaries, in partnership with Finance

- Contribute to evidence generation portfolio management by maintaining study trackers (e.g., investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations) and partnering with in preparing status, milestone and timeline overviews

- Support scientific engagement and medical education activities, including the speaker engagement process and congress planning, all scientific and non-promotional in nature

- Contribute to the TOP 41 Centers of Excellence (CoE) program, supporting the project owner in engagement mapping; this is a potential area where the post-grad trainee may take ownership of project deliverables, depending on experience and interest

- Support field medical excellence initiatives, such as field medical KPIs and dashboards, the quarterly medical insights process, training roll-out

- Contribute to patient experience work, including patient advocacy and engagement and patient support programs

- Gain first-hand insight into the regional medical leadership agenda by supporting cross-functional planning, governance meetings and operational follow-up

- Depending on experience and interest, support projects on AI-enabled tools, CRM and insights platforms, and other emerging medical priorities

Qualifications 

- Availability for a minimum of 9 months; 12 months is strongly preferred

- Completed bachelor's degree; a master's degree is a plus

- Academic background in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, public health or another analytical discipline is preferred; interest in Medical Affairs, cardiology or rare diseases is valued

- Strong logical and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate complexity and structure ambiguous problems

- Ability to read, interpret and critically summarize scientific and clinical literature

- Awareness of, or willingness to learn, the compliance principles that govern Medical Affairs

- Advance PowerPoint and Excel skills; confidence using Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity tools is highly valued

- Fast learner, proactive and adaptive, taking ownership of high-quality outputs and handling confidential information with discretion

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus

- Flexibility to work 2-3 days per week in the Zug office; occasional travel possible (mainly EU)

- Collaborative, flexible and comfortable working in a fast-moving, cross-functional and international environment

What We Bring 

- The opportunity to join a highly motivated, science-driven team in a leading RNAi therapeutics company 

- Hands-on exposure to how International Medical Affairs supports the AMVUTTRA ATTR-CM launch, with a focus on science, evidence and patients 

- The chance to contribute to Alnylam's mission of bringing groundbreaking medicines to patients 

- Direct one-to-one mentoring, supportive supervision, and regular development feedback 

- Collaboration with a diverse team of experts across medicine, scientific engagement, evidence generation, patient experience, and analytics 

- A strong office community, with events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across functions and disciplines 

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

Before applying, please review Alnylam's ⁠Candidate Privacy Notice regarding how Alnylam handles Personal Data you provide with your application for employment.

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

- Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

- Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

- Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

- Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

- Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

- You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

- You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

- Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

- You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

- Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

- Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

- Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

- Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

- Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

- Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
About Rivia 

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

About the role 

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration 

Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities.

Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes.

What excites you 

- Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth.

- Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development.

- Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes.

- Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts.

- Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales.

- Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.

What You’ll Do 

- Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring.

- Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization.

- Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution.

- Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales.

- Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers.

- Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements.

- Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities.

- Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

- Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What excites us: 

- Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers.

- A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field.

- Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers.

- Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration.

- Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates.

- Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders.

- A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment.

What Makes You Stand Out 

- Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company.

- Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows.

- Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts.

- A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

Our Values 

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

- In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

- Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

- Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

- Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

- Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

- Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

Information about the position 

You'll join Vinted's Trust & Safety domain, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. Across several detection, moderation and sanctioning teams, we run a growing set of machine learning models, rule engines, and LLM agents. They score every new listing, account and message at Vinted's scale, and many of them act on members automatically.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to shape the architecture and effectiveness of our detection systems as a whole. You'll tackle problems that individual teams cannot solve independently: how to maximize detection coverage, combine different models into coherent risk decisions, and allocate computational resources where they reduce the most harm. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with scope across Trust & Safety and Security domains. You'll set technical direction, challenge existing approaches, prototype solutions and work with teams to bring them into production.

It's an opportunity to shape how a large-scale, increasingly AI-driven safety system is built, evaluated and improved.

In this position, you’ll 

- Design the end-to-end ML architecture for detection, risk scoring, routing and decision-making.

- Develop cost-efficient, layered inference strategies that combine broad, low-latency screening with deeper, more expensive analysis where it adds the most value.

- Establish approaches to continuous risk assessment across the member lifecycle, from registration and listing creation to ongoing activity.

- Define how we measure end-to-end detection effectiveness, including precision, coverage, missed harm and computational cost. Use these measurements to identify the highest-impact improvements.

- Turn siloed, team-level models into a coherent, calibrated detection system by addressing the technical and organisational barriers that lead to local optimisation.

- Identify and close detection coverage gaps, ensuring that relevant signals and outcomes are available for evaluation, diagnosis and continuous improvement.

- Set shared technical standards and architectural direction across teams, working with engineering and data science leaders to translate them into production systems.

- Prototype critical components, test architectural assumptions empirically and build reference implementations that teams can scale.

- Explain complex ML trade-offs to senior technical and business leaders as clear choices about harm reduction, cost, and engineering investment.

About you 

- Have 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a similar role, including significant time owning production models or model evaluation at scale.

- Have led cross-team technical work without formal authority, and you're comfortable setting standards that other teams adopt.

- Have deep expertise in statistical inference and experimentation: A/B testing, measuring precision and recall under imperfect or biased labels, sampling for ground truth, and causal reasoning.

- Understand the ML lifecycle in production: evaluation, threshold setting, retraining, drift, feature stores and monitoring.

- Have hands-on experience evaluating LLM-based systems, or a strong interest in building rigorous methods for them.

- Are highly proficient in SQL and Python and comfortable working in a modern data stack (e.g. BigQuery, dbt).

- Can turn messy, cross-system problems into a clear plan, and can explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

- Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

- Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud prevention, content moderation, or risk management.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Frequent team-building events

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per working day

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

- NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

- Company bike leasing scheme

- Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

- Work from Home allowance

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

- Ability to troubleshoot equipment methodically and communicate results to colleagues across engineering disciplines.

Preferred experience 

- Precision temperature control, heat transfer or thermal instrumentation in semiconductor equipment or other precision industrial systems.

- Experience with multizone or cascade control, model-based control, sensor calibration or equipment commissioning.

- Experience with Simcenter Amesim or other tools for modeling system dynamics and validating control strategies

title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Integration Software Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions used in real-world sensing and data processing systems. 

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments. 

As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements.

This role requires a hands-on professional with a proactive mindset, a structured approach to software testing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex technical systems and translate requirements into effective test strategies.

Key Responsibilities 

- Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

- Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

- Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

- Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

- Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

- Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

- Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

- Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

- Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us? 

- Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

- Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

- Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week.

Qualifications:

- BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

- Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

- Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

- Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

- Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

- Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

- Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

- Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

- Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

- An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

- Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

- Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

- Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

- Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

- Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 

On-site and remote support 

- Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

Access & Identity (Okta)

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 

You'll need:

- Strong macOS skills and hands-on Jamf (or similar MDM) experience; working knowledge of Windows.

title: AI Builder
description:
The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages. 

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job.

The team

You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia.

Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it. 

Who you are

You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you:

Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.

You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch.

Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client.

You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it. 

Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week.

If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place. 

What you’ll get

- A competitive salary based on experience

- 25 vacation days per year

- Pension contribution

- Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility)

- A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders

- Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

- A monthly Alleo budget

- A learning budget

- Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

- A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more

Why Contentoo, why now

- You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week.

- The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero.

- The market is wide open. Most enterprises are stuck somewhere between "we bought ChatGPT licences" and "our content still isn't better". We're building the bridge, and there's no playbook for it yet.

- What you build compounds. A win for one client becomes a feature for all of them.

Sounds interesting?

Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

title: Senior China Research Analyst
description:
Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis. 

The Role: 
Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. 

You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. 

Your mission at Datenna: 

- Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. 

- Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. 

- Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. 

- Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. 

- Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. 

- Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. 

- Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. 

What makes you a great candidate: 
Core requirements 

- Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. 

- Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. 

- Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. 

- Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. 

- Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. 

- Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. 

- Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. 

- Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. 

- Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. 

Technical skills 

- Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. 

- Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. 

- Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. 

Nice to have 

- Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. 

- Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. 

- Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. 

- Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. 

- A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics. 

*Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.*

- Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies

- Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up

title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
description:

Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions

At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.

Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.

About the team

You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.

Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.

Why this role exists

Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.

This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.

The role

As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.

You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.

Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.

What you will do

- Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.

- Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.

- Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.

- Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.

- Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.

- Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.

- Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.

- At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.

Who you are

- A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.

- A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.

- Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.

- Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.

- Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.

- Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.

- Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.

- Able to represent the Product Management & AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.

- Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.

- Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.

What you’ll need

The basics

- 3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.

- Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.

- Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.

- Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.

- Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.

- Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.

- Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.

- Fluent professional English.

- Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.

Bonus points

title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
description:
Who We Are

Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure: 

- Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

- Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

- Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

- Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

- Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving: 

- Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

- Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration: 

- Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

- Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

- Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

- Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

- Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices: 

- Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

- Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

- 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

- Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

- Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

- Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

- Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

- Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

- Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

- Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

- Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

- Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

- Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

- Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

- State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

- Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

- Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

- Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

- Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

- Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus? 

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment 

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.
