title: GTM (DACH)
description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role 

We are looking for an enthusiastic, driven, and proactive commercial analyst to join our expanding DACH go-to-market team. As a key member of our commercial team, you will play a crucial role in sourcing and qualifying leads, initiating outreach, and scheduling high-value conversations for our Account Executives. Your goal will be to create meaningful connections with healthcare practices and hospital groups, facilitating our mission to win across the DACH market.

This role requires a proactive mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a high-growth startup environment. You will become an expert in engaging healthcare stakeholders, driving new opportunities, and contributing directly to the sales pipeline.

What you’ll do 

- Identify, research, and prospect potential customers and formulate go-to-market strategies

- Execute inbound and outbound campaigns using a mix of calls, emails, social selling, and product-led signals to qualify leads.

- Schedule high-quality meetings and product demonstrations for Account Executives, ensuring smooth handoff of qualified opportunities.

- Own and manage end-to-end sales cycles for small SMB customers, from initial outreach through to closing deals.

- Maintain accurate records in HubSpot CRM, manage and optimise sales pipelines, and consistently meet targets for qualified leads generated.

- Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Customer Success teams to streamline sales strategies and market positioning.

- Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and evolving customer needs to identify new opportunities.

What we're looking for 

- 1-2 years of experience in sales or in tech, banking, consulting, PE/VC or similar.

- Proven success in generating leads, qualifying prospects, and managing high-volume outreach campaigns.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, able to quickly build rapport and articulate the value of Heidi’s AI-driven healthcare solutions.

- Highly organised, disciplined, and results-oriented with a strong problem-solving ability and the ability to prioritise multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Comfortable working independently in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment with a high degree of accountability.

- Eager to learn, adaptable, and excited about professional growth opportunities.

Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.

How we show up 

- Build for the next decade, not next quarter . Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

- Lead, don't wait . We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

- Follow the evidence . Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

- Own the outcome . Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

- Ship, measure, go again . A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

- Live in clinicians' reality . Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi? 

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you. 

We chose to open-source our benefits hub , if you care to take a peek.

Wir sind PraxisEins - Deutschlands führender digitalisierter Gesundheitsversorger . Mit unserer Mission, die Primärversorgung durch Digitalisierung zu sichern, konnten wir seit Gründung 2022 bereits auf >300 Mitarbeiter wachsen. Werde auch Du Teil unserer Wachstumsstory!

Du willst Führungsverantwortung in einem schnell wachsenden Buy-and-Build übernehmen und lernen, wie man ein Venture aufbaut? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen eine:n ambitionierte:n Mitarbeiter:in als Business Development/ M&A Associate (m/f/d) in Frankfurt.

Deine Aufgaben 

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den gesamten M&A-Prozess – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme mit Hausärzt:innen bis zum Closing. Das bedeutet konkret:

- Eigenständiger Aufbau und Management deines eigenen Funnels an Akquisitionszielpraxen – du wartest nicht auf Leads, du generierst sie

- Führen von Verkäufergesprächen auf Augenhöhe: Du argumentierst klar und überzeugend für eine Partnerschaft mit PraxisEins und treibst Verhandlungen aktiv voran

- End-to-end Prozessverantwortung: Du steuerst jeden Deal selbst – ohne dass du erinnert werden musst

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem bestehenden M&A-Team und der Geschäftsführung

Dein Karrierepfad: Du startest als Associate, arbeitest eng mit dem Team zusammen und lernst unsere Prozesse und Deal-Logik kennen. Mittelfristig baust du deine eigene Region auf.

Dein Profil 

Die Rolle als Business Development/ M&A Associate (m/f/d) ist anspruchsvoll. Dir wird ein hohes Maß an Struktur und Projektmanagement-Fähigkeit abverlangt. Dabei wirst Du mit vielfältigen und oft auch unerwarteten Aufgaben konfrontiert, weshalb neben einer hervorragenden fachlichen Qualifikation auch eine hohe Belastbarkeit und eine Reihe weiterer Soft Skills notwendig sind. Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du mit:

- 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Top-Beratung, einem Start-up, im Corporate Finance oder M&A

- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch – du überzeugst Gesprächspartner:innen und weißt, wie man Verhandlungen führt

- Unternehmerische Einstellung: Du bist proaktiv, strukturiert und übernimmst Verantwortung ohne Aufforderung

- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Prozessdisziplin – du verlierst den Überblick nicht, auch wenn viele Deals parallel laufen

- Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort bei Praxen zu sein und ein Gespür für operative Realitäten zu entwickeln

- Idealerweise Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen – aber kein Muss

Was wir Dir bieten 

- Perspektive: Führungsverantwortung und eine eigene Region, die du von Grund auf aufbaust

- 30 Urlaubstage

- Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei über 6.000 Fitnessstudios deutschlandweit (EGymWellpass)

- Health Benefits wie Vorsorge-Checks und Ernährungsberatung

Über PraxisEins 

PraxisEins ist ein staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger mit einem Fokus auf den Bereichen der hausärztlichen Versorgung, Diabetologie und Schmerztherapie.

Unsere Mission 

Versorgung sichern - Qualitätsmedizin gewährleisten. Als PraxisEins wollen wir die Primärversorgung zukunftsfähig machen – mit digitaler Unterstützung, klaren Prozessen und einem Umfeld, in dem Ärztinnen und Ärzte Medizin wieder mit Freude ausüben können!

PraxisEins ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt schätzt. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen und bearbeiten diese völlig unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religionszugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behindertenstatus. Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet.

title: Customer Support Manager
description:
About Peec AI 

AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions.

Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role 

We’re looking for a Customer Support Manager to help ensure every Peec AI customer has an exceptional experience using our platform. You’ll be the first point of contact for users, answering questions, solving problems, and helping customers get the most value from Peec AI. In this role, you’ll work closely with customers, product, and engineering teams to improve support, shape onboarding, and help scale our customer experience as we grow. It’s a great opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys helping people, learning quickly, and taking ownership in a fast-moving startup environment.

What you’ll do 

- Be the first point of contact for our customers: answering questions, sharing advice, solving problems, and keeping satisfaction sky-high

- Co-own our Product Documentation and Help Center and prepare drafts, screenshots & GIFs

- Jump on calls with leading brands and agencies, ensuring they feel supported, heard, and championed across our product and engineering teams

- Act as the voice of the customer, providing actionable feedback to marketing, sales, and product

- Onboarding new colleagues to our support processes and helping them with day-to-day questions

- Help design and scale our CX process - from improving our help center to optimizing our AI assistant and support workflows to make your own life easier every day

- Support the launch of customer initiatives like events, webinars, and AMA sessions to engage and grow our user community

What we’re looking for 

- 2+ years of Customer Success or Support experience, ideally at a fast-growing SaaS startup

- Familiarity with help desk systems and other support tools such as Intercom, Zendesk or Plain

- A self-driven, AI-native problem-solver who knows how to get shit done

- Clear and warm communication skills - whether over email, chat, or live calls

- English and German language fluency

Bonus Points 

- Exposure to customer support automation & reporting

- Basic SEO/GEO skills and first touchpoints with tools in that space

- Experience working in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment

What we offer 

- Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe’s fastest-growing Series A startups

- Regular team events and offsites

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

- Paid Meal and Uber rides home when working late

- One of the most beautiful office spaces and work environments in Berlin

Compensation: €55K – €70K • Offers Equity

Requirement: Senior Project Transition Manager

Location: Wiesbaden, DE

Full Time On-Site: Yes

Time On-Site: 100% 

Total Scope of the request (hours): 350

Required Start Date: 7 December 2026

End Contract Date: 31 December 2026 

Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET

Duties & Role: 

Project Transition to Operations 

- Leads the transition of projects and capabilities into operational service, from early engagement in project planning through to formal handover and early life support.
- Defines and agrees transition plans, entry and exit criteria, service acceptance criteria and handover deliverables with Project Managers, Service Owners and customers.
- Ensures operational readiness prior to go-live: support model, staffing, training, documentation, spares, underpinning contracts, monitoring and configuration data are in place.
- Evaluates project outputs against agreed service acceptance criteria and formally recommends acceptance, conditional acceptance or rejection.
- Identifies, manages and escalates transition risks, issues and dependencies, and ensures residual risks are understood and owned by operations.
- Manages early life support and closes transition only when agreed service performance has been demonstrated.
- Captures and applies lessons identified to improve future transitions.
Local Operations Management (Wiesbaden) 

- Takes accountability for the day-to-day delivery of NCIA services at the location, including service performance, customer satisfaction and compliance with security and safety requirements.
- Leads and coordinates local technical, support and contractor personnel, setting clear priorities, standards and direction.
- Oversees the local infrastructure (facilities, networks, data centre / server rooms, end-user and deployable CIS assets) and ensures it is maintained, secured and fit for purpose.
- Ensures asset and configuration management records for the location are accurate and complete.
- Coordinates local business continuity and service recovery arrangements.
Incident and Problem Management

- Leads the resolution of major incidents, coordinating technical teams, vendors and customers, and provides timely, accurate communication to senior stakeholders.

- Initiates and monitors problem investigations, drives root cause analysis and ensures preventive measures are implemented.

- Monitors service performance and key performance indicators, diagnoses service delivery problems and initiates improvement actions.

Cost, Resource and Vendor Management

- Provides inputs to customer budget processes, cost models and service rates, ensuring the full cost of operating transitioned services is identified and funded.
- Identifies cost optimisation opportunities without compromising service levels or security.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
You'll ship agents that move money, and you'll keep the rhythm that gets them shipped. Accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury: autonomous agents that read the invoice, match it, negotiate the discount, release the payment, and reconcile the cash. Every one of those actions runs in production with a customer's CFO watching the result.

Most of what the industry calls engineering culture was written for a world where humans typed every line. That world ended. We want to build the 2026 version: engineers who work with agents as a matter of course, where the unit of work is the loop (spec, generate, evaluate, correct, ship) rather than the ticket, where code review means reviewing the evals and prompts as hard as the diff, and where a regression suite over real customer invoices is what lets us move fast on systems that touch money. Nobody has a settled playbook for this. You'll help write ours, from inside a pod.

This is a player-coach role. You'll spend most of your week shipping code in one of our pods, and you'll manage the engineers day to day: 1:1s, feedback, growth, the hard conversation when it's needed. The rest goes to the delivery rhythm: pods commit to milestones in Linear, post progress daily, and review misses every Friday with the Head of Product and the CTO. You run that review and the follow-ups. The management share grows as we go from 8 engineers to 16 and beyond; this role is the natural path to Head of Engineering. You'll report to the CTO. Causa Prima is built by the team behind Taulia and backed by Creandum.

What you'll do 

- Ship as a senior engineer, 70 to 80% of your week. Take the hardest work in your pod, unblock the integration nobody wants, and review the code that touches money personally. You set the bar by clearing it in front of the team.

- Manage the engineers day to day. Weekly 1:1s, direct feedback, growth plans, and the honest conversation about who's ready for more scope and who's in the wrong seat. The CTO owns hiring decisions and the technical direction; the people in the pods are yours.

- Run the delivery rhythm. Weekly milestone commitments, the Friday review, the dashboard of committed versus delivered, and the follow-ups when something slips. Misses are discussed to learn, not to blame; your job is that they get discussed at all, with an owner and a next step.

- Make the loop the way we work. Specs written so an agent can execute them, evals that run before merge, review practices that treat prompts as code. The CTO owns the architecture; you own that every pod actually works this way, including the change management when they don't.

- Raise risk early. You know on Tuesday what won't make Friday, and so does everyone who needs to.

- Sit with customers. Controllers explaining why the agent's match was technically correct and operationally wrong. AP leads walking you through an SAP extension nobody documented. That's where the next milestone comes from.

What we're looking for 

- A senior engineer who likes the operational side. You've shipped production systems where mistakes cost money: fintech, payments, ERP-adjacent, enterprise B2B. You've also managed engineers, run their 1:1s and a delivery cadence, and liked it enough to want more of it while still writing code.

- You build with agents. You've shipped something in the last month using an agentic coding tool that saved you a week, and you can show us. Python or TypeScript in anger, and enough PostgreSQL to review a migration without asking.

- You've kept commitments reliable before, with numbers. Committed versus shipped, cycle time, whatever you tracked. You've followed up on slipped work without it turning into a blame exercise.

- Minimal process instincts. You add a ritual when it earns its place and remove it when it doesn't. A weekly review that takes 30 minutes, not 90.

- You can disagree with a founder and stay in the room. We hire for trust and challenge in that order.

- Fluent English. German or Spanish is a plus. Munich preferred, Madrid works. You'll be in both offices regularly.

This is a wishlist, not a checklist. If the role excites you but you don't tick every box, we would encourage you to apply anyway.

Nice to have 

- AI agents in production, as the product rather than a feature.

- Depth in purchase-to-pay or order-to-cash, or scar tissue from an SAP integration.

- You've grown with a team through a Series A or B.

- Former founder or founding engineer.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Staff Engineer

You'll be the most senior engineer on the agents that run finance operations for our customers — designing, building, and operating the autonomous agents that handle accounts payable and receivable end-to-end. From invoice validation and dispute resolution to cross-company negotiation and cash optimization.

This is an individual-contributor role at the top of our ladder: no direct reports, full technical authority over the architecture the rest of the team builds on.

What you'll do

- Agent architecture — Design the multi-agent system: agent boundaries, event contracts, orchestration patterns, and the separation between LLM reasoning and deterministic enforcement. - Agentic dispute resolution — An agent that reads the claim, gathers the evidence from the PO, contract, and delivery record, forms a position, and works it to settlement — negotiating with the counterparty where that's appropriate, escalating to a human where it isn't. - Agentic dynamic discounting — Agents that continuously price early payment against the cash position on both sides of the transaction, propose terms, and execute them. Static payment terms become a negotiation that runs on its own.

- Matching and reconciliation — Three-way matching across purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice with configurable tolerances; cash application against bank statements and remittance advices, including partial payments and residuals; the exception paths that follow when any of it fails. - Validation & anomaly detection — Business rule checks, duplicate and near-duplicate detection, pricing discrepancy detection, and anomaly detection across time. Precision matters as much as recall here: a false positive is a blocked supplier and an angry procurement lead.

- Platform & data infrastructure — Own the primitives every agent action rests on: an append-only PostgreSQL event store with tamper-evident hash chaining for replay and audit; cryptographic signature verification on agent events and approval chains before anything external fires; the Workflow Constraint Engine that gates payments, emails, and API calls on deterministic policy, not model output; row-level multi-tenancy and tenant-scoped credentials across every data store; attribute-based authorization via Cerbos, evaluated the same way whether the caller is an agent or a human; and the MCP security layer — auth, capability-scoping, rate limiting — for external agent-to-agent access.

- The engineering standard — Architecture decision records, review bar, on-call, and a clear view of what we deliberately don't build. You'll write the things the next ten engineers read in week one, and you'll spend time with controllers and AP leads watching agents fail in ways no test predicted.

What we're looking for

- Strong systems design thinking — agent boundaries, failure modes, trust boundaries, contract evolution. Money movement is not retry-safe by default and you already know why.

- Depth in Python and/or TypeScript in production, and deep PostgreSQL: event sourcing, row-level security, indexing tradeoffs, schema evolution under load.

- Hands-on experience with LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or similar), and document AI (LlamaIndex, LlamaParse, or similar).

title: Consultant Presales & Solutions (m/w/d)
description:
Du verstehst Prozesse schneller als andere und willst Kunden mit einer Lösung überzeugen, die wirklich passt? Dann verbinde bei uns Beratung, Technik und Vertrieb in einer Rolle. 

Wer wir sind

docu-fix digitalisiert den sozialwirtschaftlichen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren Prozesse rund um Dokumente: Scan-Dienstleistungen, Dokumentenmanagement (u. a. DocuWare), Workflows und E-Signatur. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Träger der Sozialwirtschaft, Rechenzentren und öffentliche Verkehrsbetriebe.

Unsere Kunden sparen mit uns bis zu 80 % ihrer Prozesskosten – mit einer Lösung, die EU-konform ist. Wir wachsen stark, und unser Vertrieb liefert immer mehr qualifizierte Termine. Damit aus diesen Terminen Projekte werden, suchen wir dich.

Was du machst

- Du übernimmst die Termine, die unser Inside Sales vereinbart, und führst sie bis zum Abschluss.

- Du nimmst Prozesse auf. Im Erstgespräch und im Workshop fragst du so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo beim Kunden Zeit und Geld liegen bleiben.

- Du zeigst die Lösung. In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess – nicht eine Standardpräsentation.

- Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen.

- Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung.

- Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar.

- Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen.

Worauf du dich einstellst

- Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe und andere Vorgaben – du baust daraus eine Lösung, die trägt.

- Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Buchhaltung. Die eine will Zahlen, die andere Architektur, die dritte einen Alltag, der funktioniert.

- Du stehst zwischen Vertrieb und Technik. Du versprichst nur, was unser Implementierungsteam liefern kann.

- Du arbeitest an mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig und hältst Fristen für Angebote und Ausschreibungen.

- Du bist bei Kunden vor Ort und online unterwegs.

Wen wir suchen

- Du hast Erfahrung in Presales, Consulting, Business Analyse oder der Einführung von Unternehmenssoftware.

- Du denkst in Prozessen. Du verstehst, wie ein Rechnungseingang, eine Freigabe oder eine Aktenführung abläuft, und siehst, wo es hakt.

- Du erklärst Technik so, dass eine Geschäftsführung entscheidet und eine IT-Leitung zustimmt.

- Du bist technisch fit: Schnittstellen, Cloud und On-Premises, Berechtigungen und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut. Programmieren musst du nicht.

- Du schreibst Konzepte und Angebote, die man ohne Rückfrage versteht.

- Du arbeitest selbstständig, verbindlich und gern im Team mit Vertrieb und Technik.

- Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch, weil Workshops, Konzepte und Angebote auf Deutsch laufen.

Hilft, ist aber kein Muss

- Erfahrung mit DocuWare oder anderen DMS-, ECM- oder Workflow-Systemen

- Kenntnis der Sozialwirtschaft, des öffentlichen Sektors oder von ERP- und Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen

- Erfahrung mit E-Rechnung, E-Signatur oder revisionssicherer Archivierung

Was dir fehlt, bringen wir dir bei.

- The opportunity to work for a leading provider of semiconductor process equipment

- A varied and dynamic international environment

At every step, we recognize that it is our valued employees who enable us to deliver outstanding products and services to our customers—and to make a positive impact on society.

title: Android Software Engineer
description:
About ActAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role 

As an Android Software Engineer, you own the Android client experience, how AI feels, behaves, and performs on mobile devices. This is not a thin client role. You will build a production Android application where AI interactions are core to the product, and performance, reliability, and clarity matter.

Focus 

- Build and maintain production Android apps using Kotlin.

- Integrate AI-powered features (chat, vision, voice, recommendations) via backend APIs.

- Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including streaming responses, retries, and partial results.

- Optimize performance, memory usage, and responsiveness for AI-heavy flows.

- Implement analytics, logging, and feedback capture to support AI evaluation and iteration.

- Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API contracts and system behavior.

- Ensure app stability, security, and scalability in production environments.

Ideal Experiences 

- 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

- Hands-on experience integrating AI features (e.g. LLM, vision, speech APIs).

- Strong understanding of asynchronous programming (Coroutines, Flow).

- Familiarity with REST or gRPC APIs and structured data formats.

- Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

- Comfort building in environments with latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic behavior.

- Experience with MLKit or light on-device inference.

- Published production apps on the Google Play Store.

Outcomes 

- Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use android applications.

- Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

- Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

Tech Stack 

- Kotlin / Java

- SQL / noSQL

- TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

How We Work 

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process 

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
About ActAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role 

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You Will Be Doing 

- Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

- Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

- Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

- Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

- Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

- Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

- Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What You Will Need 

- Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

- Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

- Comfortable working across different business functions.

- Strong ownership and execution skills.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

- Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

How We Work 

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process 

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

description:
Du sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit, Stabilität und Transparenz im Herzen unserer Organisation. 

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die korrekte Buchführung und die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen in einem vielseitigen Unternehmensumfeld. Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle, begleitest steuerliche Prozesse und unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte.

In einem schlanken, dynamischen Team bringst du deine Sorgfalt, dein Fachwissen und deine Hands-on-Mentalität ein und trägst damit wesentlich zur finanziellen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation bei.

Über uns 

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen. Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.

Deine Chance 

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, deine Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussexpertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld einzubringen.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die sachgerechte Abbildung von Geschäftsvorfällen, die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und die Mitwirkung an internen Berichtsprozessen. Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, bringst dein Fachwissen in steuerliche und treasury-bezogene Themen ein und sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit und Stabilität.

Bilanzierung & Jahresabschlüsse 

- Du erstellst Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB für mehrere Gesellschaften.

- Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle und stellst eine korrekte buchhalterische Abbildung sicher.

- Du wirkst bei der Optimierung von Bilanzierungs- und Reportingprozessen mit.

Finanzreporting & Steuern 

- Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte sowie interner Reportings

- Du kümmerst dich um umsatz- und ertragssteuerliche Fragestellungen und deren Umsetzung.

- Du trägst zur Einhaltung steuerlicher Vorschriften und zur Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern bei.

Treasury & Zahlungsverkehr

- Du stellst eine strukturierte und termingerechte Abwicklung sicher.

Tools & Prozessverbesserung 

- Du arbeitest routiniert mit ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP, Lexware) sowie Google Workspace.

Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung auf zukünftige Reporting- und Digitalisierungsvorhaben.

title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
description:
About pplwise 

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics 

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role 

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do 

- Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

- Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

- Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

- Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

- Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

- Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

- Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

- Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you 

- Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

- A proven record of taking an electromechanical product from prototype to series production (ideally 1,000+ units a year) on a fast development cycle of about a year, not a decade-long program

- You still design hands-on in CAD, mainly metal parts and assemblies, with strong tolerancing skills (any CAD tool; Onshape is a plus)

- You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts

- At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; a team-lead title isn't required

- Experience testing and integrating mechanics with electronics

- You've introduced processes, design reviews or engineering standards that helped a team deliver

- You handle unclear requirements and break complex problems down so others can work on them

- German is a plus, since production is mostly German-speaking

- Bonus: GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, design of production jigs, or projects with motors, motor controllers or electronics

What Filics offers 

- A key role at an early stage: shape both the mechanical team and the product

- Real ownership of the mechanical side, from first prototype to series production

- A mix of hands-on engineering and leadership, with a path into team lead and engineering management as Filics grows

- Fast design cycles driven by customer and field feedback

- A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across mechanics, electronics, software and production

- Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

- An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

Dank seines Double-Runner-Systems ist Filics der erste und einzige AMR, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten hindurchfahren kann. Damit bricht Filics mit der Logik des Gabelstaplers und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Filics ist ein kleines, anpackendes Team, das schwierige Probleme mit technischer Exzellenz löst. - Du planst Verbesserungen im Büro und setzt sie um, während das Team wächst

- Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit Vermieter, Facility Management und externen Dienstleistern

- Du empfängst Gäste, Bewerbende und Partner im Büro

- Du unterstützt HR bei der Planung von Meetings und Vorstellungsgesprächen und organisierst Reisen und Transfers für Bewerbende und Gäste

- Du bereitest das Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder vor Ort vor, z. B. Arbeitsplatz, Schlüssel und Ausstattung

- Du organisierst Office-Aktivitäten und Team-Events, die das Team zusammenbringen

Dein Profil 

- Erfahrung im Office Management oder in der Administration, idealerweise in einem Start-up oder wachsenden Unternehmen

- Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du gibst Informationen klar und auf den Punkt weiter

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung und packst an, was zu tun ist, ohne darauf zu warten, dass dich jemand fragt

Das bietet Filics

title: Support Analyst (German Speaking)
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission 
As Support Analyst, you will serve as the frontline technical and functional expert for customers using the Hawk platform, ensuring a seamless user experience. You will provide expert guidance on rule configuration, user management, workflows, and integration troubleshooting via our ticketing system while collaborating with internal teams to resolve complex issues. We are seeking a proactive problem solver, who can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders fluently in German and English and ensure high customer satisfaction. 

Your Responsibilities 

- Provide timely, high-quality support for customers via our ticketing system, assisting with rule configuration, user management, workflow optimization, and integrations.

- Troubleshoot rule behaviour and configuration issues and investigate why alerts trigger (or don’t) and identifying root causes across data, configuration, and platform behaviour.

- Diagnose, prioritize, and resolve system errors, collaborating with engineers and product teams to identify root causes and implement fixes.

- Notify customers of incidents, document root cause analyses in collaboration with engineers, and ensure clear communication throughout the resolution process.

- Work closely with internal teams to resolve complex issues, escalate critical cases, and relay customer feedback for product improvements.

- Participate professionally in international video conference calls, providing clear, concise explanations of technical issues and solutions to a diverse customer base.

- Develop comprehensive documentation for both technical and non-technical users, ensuring clarity in troubleshooting steps, platform functionality, and best practices.

- Apply your understanding of Fraud Prevention, Compliance, and/or Payments Processing to guide customers effectively in a highly regulated and complex environment. 

Your Profile 

- 3+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or a customer-facing technical role.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose issues in SaaS applications.

- Experience working with ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow) and monitoring tools.

- Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical users.

- Familiarity with financial crime prevention, fraud detection, compliance, or payments processing is highly desirable.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in a customer-facing role.

- Highly organized, able to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable participating in international calls across multiple time zones.

- German and English fluency 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in AML, Fraud Prevention, or Compliance platforms

- Familiarity with cloud-based platforms, APIs, and integrations

- Previous experience in a SaaS, FinTech, or RegTech company

title: (Senior) Consultant – Healthcare Data & Strategy (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Statista Healthcare 
Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista, focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties. We work with leading healthcare stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized consulting projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital rating is published in collaboration with our trusted media partner Newsweek, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets.

We help healthcare organizations define relevant key performance indicators, validate and harmonize data structures, and translate insights into actionable strategies. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

In our consulting projects, we support healthcare providers and systems in developing tailored KPI frameworks, standardizing and validating data processes, and deriving actionable insights that enable measurable improvements in patient care and system-level performance. We combine structured methodologies with hands-on delivery to unlock the full value of healthcare quality data.

Your Role

title: Founding Account Executive
description:
About BoWatt 

BoWatt is building AI agents for requirements and systems engineering in manufacturing. We help the teams engineering cars, planes, rockets, factories, chips, and medical devices tackle complex engineering work with software.

We bootstrapped to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. Our investors include Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, alongside angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious Account Executive to turn customer interest into closed deals.

The role 

You want to become exceptional at selling. You’re early in your sales career, but you’ve already shown that you learn fast, create opportunities, and take ownership of results.

At BoWatt, you’ll own your pipeline from first conversation to signed customer. You’ll sell a technical product to manufacturing companies across DACH, learn directly from our CEO, and help turn what works into a repeatable sales process.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not a sales-management position. You don’t need to have built a sales team. You do need the drive and judgement to move deals forward without waiting for a finished playbook.

What you’ll do 

- Build pipeline through targeted outbound, alongside leads generated with BDR support.

- Run discovery with engineering and business stakeholders to understand their workflows, pain points, and buying process.

- Deliver tailored product demos and build a clear business case for BoWatt.

- Own opportunities through qualification, pilot discussions, negotiation, and close.

- Keep your CRM and forecasts accurate, with clear next steps for every opportunity.

- Bring customer feedback to the product team and help improve our messaging, demos, and sales process.

What you bring 

- Early experience in B2B software or technical sales. You may already be closing deals as an AE, or be a standout SDR/BDR ready to take on the full sales cycle.

- Evidence that you perform: targets exceeded, pipeline you created, deals you helped win, rapid progression, or a business you built yourself. We care more about what you’ve done than your title or years of experience.

- The curiosity to understand a technical product and explain its value clearly. Manufacturing experience helps, but isn’t required.

- Strong communication: you ask good questions, listen carefully, and make the next step clear.

- Resilience and initiative. You follow up, handle rejection, and find ways to make progress.

- Fluent German and professional English, our internal working language.

- Willingness to work from our Munich office four days per week.

What we offer 

- Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission.

- Meaningful equity

- Close collaboration with the CEO and hands-on onboarding into our product, customers, and industry.

- Ownership of real customer relationships and room to take on larger deals and greater responsibility as you develop.

- A small team of experienced startup builders and former founders.

- 25 vacation days plus public holidays, company retreats, and WellPass membership.

Interview process 

- 20-minute introductory call.

- 90-minute sales interview with the CEO and a team member.

- 60-minute culture and team interview.

- References and offer.

We aim to complete the process within 14 days.

title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications. 

Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives. 

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts. 

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment. 

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations. 

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks. 

What You Will Do 

- Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay. 

- Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa. 

- Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC). 

- Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation. 

- Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates. 

- Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions. 

- Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers. 

- Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements. 

- Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications. 

What We Expect of You 

Essential Skills & Experience 

- Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices. 

- Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments. 

- Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages. 

- Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols. 

- Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules. 

- Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications. 

- Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting. 

- Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations. 

- A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus. 

Valuable Experience 

- Practical knowledge of Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC), Infor ION Framework and Infor OS, including their integration with Infor M3 and the routing of EDI documents into core applications. 

- Familiarity with Mapping Manager and Business Document Mapper within the Infor integration environment. 

- Onboarding customers, suppliers and 3 PLs via EDI. 

Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position. 

About Intersnack IT: 

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. Our goal is to provide a common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services, and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG . 

About Intersnack Group: 

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. For further company insights, please visit the following link: Intersnack Group Overview 

If you want to be part of our dynamic food industry success story, you’ll find all sorts of opportunities at Intersnack. Join our team, help us grow, and celebrate our successes together!

title: Product Manager MISSION AIRCRAFT (m/f/d)
description:
About the role:

As Product Manager Mission Aircraft, you will own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of our military multi-mission aircraft. The aircraft is designed as an optionally piloted platform combining manned and unmanned operations with modular mission capabilities for applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming.

You will work at the intersection of customer needs, operational requirements, engineering feasibility and commercial viability. In close collaboration with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Product Marketing and other stakeholders, you will translate complex mission needs into clear product priorities and an executable roadmap. This end-to-end ownership, from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery and lifecycle development, is consistent with Quantum Systems' current Product Management model

What is your Day to Day Mission: 

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Mission Aircraft, translating market, customer and operational requirements into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes.

- Drive customer and market discovery by engaging with end users, governmental customers, Sales and Solutions teams to understand operational challenges, mission scenarios and capability gaps.

- Shape the multi-mission capability roadmap across relevant applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming.

- Drive payload and mission-system integration such as radar, EO/IR, SIGINT, communications and other mission-specific payloads.

Lead product trade-off decisions across performance, payload, endurance, platform constraints, cost, risk, certification and time-to-market.

- Own product readiness and lifecycle decisions, defining acceptance criteria and supporting validation, release readiness, market introduction and continuous product improvement.

- Create cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, Programs, Sales, Product Marketing and external technology partners, clearly communicating priorities, dependencies, risks and roadmap decisions.

What you bring to the team: 

- You have completed a degree/apprenticeship in the field of ...

- You already have at least X years of professional/practical experience in ...

- You are privately interested in ...

- Due to your open, communicative, friendly and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered as an internal expert.

- You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently.

- Communication in English is a matter of course for you.

Why Quantum-Systems: 

- You have a degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field.

- You have several years of experience in technical Product Management, Systems Engineering or product development within aerospace, defence, UAS, aviation or another complex hardware-software environment.

- You have experience taking technically complex products or capabilities from customer need and concept through development, validation and market or operational deployment.

- You have a strong technical understanding and are comfortable working across aircraft systems, hardware, software, sensors, communications and mission-system integration.

- You have strong commercial judgement and can balance customer value, operational utility, technical feasibility, cost, schedule and product scalability.

- Ideally, you have experience with military aviation, UAS, ISR, Counter-UAS, mission systems, payload integration or manned-unmanned teaming.

- You are comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information and can bring structure and clarity to complex stakeholder discussions.

- Communicating in English comes naturally to you; German is a plus. Similar current Quantum Systems Product Manager roles require fluent English and treat German as advantageous.

Our benefits: 

- Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

- Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

- Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

- Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

- Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

- Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

title: Senior Product Engineer (£80k-125k + Equity)
description:
👋 Hey! We're Conveo.ai 

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~120 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

The engineering team is small and deliberately so. There are no product managers, no designer handoffs, no tickets waiting for someone else to prioritise. Engineers own the full distance from customer problem to working software, and that proximity to the product is exactly what makes this role interesting. You'll report directly to one of our engineering leads, and work incredibly closely with our CTO, Maarten.

Dig deeper into our Engineering/Product ways of working 👉 here 👈

What we're building and why

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

What you'll do

We need a Senior Product Engineer who works backwards from the experience. This is someone who starts with the user's problem, not a spec, and owns everything between that conversation and the code that ships. You shape what gets built, actively contributing to product direction, influencing what we build and how we build it, with real technical and strategic impact.

Own the full stack, from the interface to the infrastructure 

Build the interface customers open every day and can't imagine working without. React is the core of what customers see and touch — you lead frontend architecture in React and TypeScript, set the quality bar for components, state management, and performance. And you don't stop there. From API design to cloud infrastructure (AWS), you ship complete, polished features end to end, including AI-powered ones built on LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and async pipelines.

Be the engineering voice in every customer conversation 

When a customer has a need, an engineer hears it, interprets it, and solves it. You join customer calls (about once a week), form a clear point of view on what to build, translate feedback into scoped product decisions, and follow through.

Use AI throughout 

You reach for agentic solutions first. You use AI to reason, build, review, and test at every stage and you help raise the bar for how the whole team works. Documentation overhead doesn't slow us down here — AI handles that layer, and you're someone who is happy to work that way. You stay current on what frontier models can do and bring that into what we ship.

What you'll bring

- 6+ years of experience building full-stack applications with TypeScript and Node.js.

- Strong backend experience: designing APIs, working with PostgreSQL, and managing background jobs and async workflows.

- Solid frontend skills with React. .

- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) — you're comfortable with services like S3, media pipelines, and deployment tooling.

- Experience building AI-driven applications (e.g. prompt engineering, working with LLM APIs, and/or fine-tuning experience are a plus).

- Can independently lead projects from concept to launch.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with a keen eye for detail.

- A collaborative mindset, able to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced team.

Bonus

- Experience with React Router v7 or Remix.

- Experience at a small, fast-moving SaaS company where you’ve been client-facing

- Exposure to market research or qualitative research tooling.

- You've shipped agentic AI systems to production and can speak to failure modes, evaluations, and tool design.

Why join us? 

- Ship alongside engineers who've built and scaled products used by millions.

- Work directly with frontier AI models and push what they can actually do.

- Join a YC-backed team that's growing fast and gives you room to grow with it.

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity. We want you to own a real piece of what we're building.

- Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so we ask for 3 days a week in the office.

- Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more.

- Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to. Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal. 

- Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

- Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

- Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Platform
description:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

The role 

Physical engineering is one of the hardest domains for AI. Designs have to meet standards, calculations must be deterministic and checkable, and a wrong number can end up in a power system or a data centre. CurieOS is built to let agents do real engineering work and to show exactly how every output was produced.

The platform team builds the foundation that every workflow, agent and product on CurieOS depends on, and runs it in production for people who need to trust it. Your work sets the floor for how reliable our AI is, and the ceiling for what it can do.

This is a small team, and you'll shape what we build as well as how. You'll see the results of those decisions in production within days. If you want a narrow, well-defined slice of a large system, this isn't the role. If you want to own a platform while it scales, it is.

How we work 

We build with agents, not just for them. Everyone on the team works with the latest frontier models and coding agents every day, and token budgets won't hold you back. Part of what we build is CurieOS's ability to work on itself: triaging defects, proposing fixes and opening pull requests for engineers to review. So engineers here spend more of their time on design, review and judgement, and less on typing. If you already work this way, you'll feel at home. If you want to see how far it can go, this is the place to find out.

You'll also work alongside our AI researchers, turning cutting-edge research and evals into things that run in the platform and in production.

What you'll work on first 

In your first six months you'll work across the parts of CurieOS that customers have to be able to trust. Like everyone on the team you'll touch most of them, and go deepest where your interests take you:

- Tenancy, isolation and identity. How CurieOS keeps each customer separate, from shared multi-tenant accounts to dedicated single-tenant deployments. That covers data isolation, SSO and access control. You'll also be an engineering voice in customer security reviews.

- Release and production. How changes get to production safely: release gates, staged rollouts and rollback, automated smoke tests, on-call and incident response. We ship often, and you'll build what lets us keep doing that without breaking what customers rely on.

- Agent quality in production. Measuring how well agents perform on real customer workflows, working with our researchers to bring the latest evals into the platform, and using those measurements to decide what is good enough to release. A model or prompt change should have to pass the same gate as a code change.

- Observability and cost. Knowing the platform is healthy and what it costs. That means SLOs, tracing and alerting, plus cost telemetry and usage metering for every workflow and every customer, so we can see where model and compute spend goes and make deliberate choices about it.

- Infrastructure and deployment. One standard for how CurieOS is deployed, configured and upgraded in each environment, across our own cloud accounts, GPU capacity and customer-dedicated deployments.

Where the platform is going 

Once those foundations are solid, there's a lot to shape next:

- Traceable results. Provenance for every number an agent produces: which inputs, tools, models and versions went into it, so our users can check it and sign it off.

- Agent runtime and context. How agents plan, call tools, manage context across long-running work and hand off to people at the right moment.

- Durable workflows. Orchestration that survives failures, retries and runs lasting hours, mixing agent steps with deterministic calculations.

At Staff level, you'd set technical direction across these areas, not just within one. - Designed and built backend services that other teams or customers relied on, and made the key decisions yourself.

- Built and run something where LLMs do real work for real users, and dealt with the cost, latency and quality trade-offs that come with it.
