You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan . You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now 

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do 

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

- Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

- Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

- Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem

Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

- Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

- Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

- Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

- Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

- Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

- Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't 

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

- It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

- It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

- It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for 

- 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

- A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

- Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

- Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

- A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

- Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

- You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make. 

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’ , never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘ Simply to accelerate ', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process. 

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

What You Bring

- A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care.

- Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset.

- Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs).

- Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts.

Location

We believe great ideas thrive when we connect in person. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Leiden with occasional travel to meet the core team in Stockholm and clinicians across the country as needed

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

- Screening interview with Talent Acquisition 

- First interview with our NL Country Director 

- Follow up interview with of our NL Medical Operations team lead

- Working Day - Join us in the Leiden office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

title: Datenschutzkoordinator / IT-Sicherheitskoordinator (w/m/d)
description:
Als Datenschutz- und IT-Sicherheitskoordinator (w/m/d) koordinierst Du Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit bei Stackfuel in Deutschland und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem Compliance Team um. Du bist der Brückenkopf zur Datenschutzbeauftragten (DPO) und zum CISO in UK und sorgst dafür, dass DSGVO und Kundenanforderungen pragmatisch und effizient umgesetzt werden. So minimierst Du Risiken und ermöglichst den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz moderner Technologien.

Du kommst in einer entscheidenden Phase unserer Wachstumsgeschichte zu uns und verstehst Compliance als Enabler: Teams arbeiten schnell und sicher, Kund:innen vertrauen uns. Du berichtest an den Head of Product Compliance.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle

1. Datenschutzkoordination 

- Pflege von Verarbeitungsverzeichnis, TOM-Dokumentation, Löschkonzepten, Datenschutzhinweisen und Einwilligungsprozessen

- Prüfung von Auftragsverarbeitungsverträgen sowie neuen Tools und Dienstleistern

- Bearbeitung von Betroffenenanfragen, Vorbereitung von Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen

- Behandlung von Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsvorfällen inkl. Meldeprozessen

2. Informationssicherheit 

- Koordination von Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines schlanken ISMS inkl. Risikoanalysen und Sicherheitsrichtlinien, abgestimmt mit dem DE- und UK-Compliance- und Security-Team

- Steuerung technischer und organisatorischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen mit IT-Abteilung und UK-Sicherheitsteam, inkl. Notfallvorsorge und Incident Response

3. Awareness & Schulung 

- Schulung und Sensibilisierung der Mitarbeitenden

4. Regulatorik & Lieferkette 

- Beobachtung und Bewertung von NIS-2, Cyber Resilience Act und AI Act

- Lieferantenbewertung inkl. Sicherheitsfragebögen, Beantwortung von Kundenanforderungen und Unterstützung bei Audits

- Regelmäßige Abstimmung mit DPO und CISO in UK

Das bringst Du mit

- Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. (Wirtschafts-)Informatik) oder IT-Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung in Informationssicherheit

- 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Datenschutz und IT-Sicherheit

title: General Application - Join our Talent Community!
description:
About TACTILIA 

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now.

Your work will contribute to turning advanced robotics into reliable, manufacturable and deployable technology for real-world industrial applications.

Don't see the right role? 

Great people don't always fit neatly into an existing job description. If you're excited about what we're building but haven't found a suitable opening, we'd still love to hear from you!

We're always interested in meeting people who want to help shape the future of robotics and Physical AI, whether your expertise lies in:

- Engineering & Robotics: Mechanical engineering, electronics, actuators, embedded systems, controls, robotics and system integration.

- Software & AI: Robotics software, machine learning, perception, motion planning and software development.

- Product & Industrialisation: Product development, testing, manufacturing, quality, reliability and technical operations.

- Business & Commercial: Business development, sales, marketing, partnerships and customer success.

- Operations & Corporate Functions: Supply chain, finance, people, administration and other areas that help a growing company succeed.

If you bring a different skill set that you believe could make a difference at TACTILIA, we want to hear from you.

What happens next? 

Tell us a little about yourself, your experience and what you'd like to contribute to TACTILIA. Share your CV and, if available, your LinkedIn profile. Our team will review your application and get in touch if we see a potential match with our current or future opportunities. If there isn't an immediate fit, we'd be happy to stay connected for relevant opportunities down the road, subject to your consent.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. 

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Privacy & Talent Community 

By submitting your application, you agree that TACTILIA may retain your application details for up to 12 months to consider you for future opportunities. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do: 

- Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

- Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

- Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

- Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

- Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

- Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

- Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.

Workplace: 

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin. 

Who you are: 

- You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years and a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

- You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

- You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

- You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

- You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar).

- Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar).

- You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

- Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect: 

- You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

- You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

- You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

- We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

- You will get a competitive salary.

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

description:
About IndieKidz 

IndieKidz GmbH is a Berlin-based startup building Occibo, an AI-powered platform that helps authors, illustrators, parents, and teachers create, design, and publish children's books. We are a small, international team, and we are looking for someone who can show the world what Occibo does and why it matters.

Company: Occibo | IndieKidz GmbH
Location: Remote
Type: Internship | Unpaid 

Period: 3-6 month (6 month preferred)

About the Role

Occibo is an AI-powered children's book creation platform for authors, parents, teachers, and illustrators.

We're an early-stage startup testing our MVP and looking for a creative, proactive Marketing & Sales Intern to help us grow our online presence, create engaging content, and connect with potential customers and beta users.

You'll work directly with our founders and design team, gaining hands-on experience in digital marketing, social media, growth marketing, and customer acquisition .

What you will do 

- Social Media Marketing: Plan, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube.

- Content Creation: Develop content ideas with our graphic design team, write captions, and occasionally create Reels, Shorts, and product demos.

- Trend Research: Find viral content ideas, monitor competitors, and explore creative growth strategies.

- Marketing Analytics: Track reach, engagement, and conversions to improve content performance.

- Sales & Lead Generation: Identify and contact potential customers, interested authors, educators, and beta users.

- Beta User Outreach: Manage invitations, follow-ups, onboarding coordination, and feedback collection.

- Community Management: Engage with followers, respond to messages, and help grow our online community.

Requirements

What you bring 

- Student or recent graduate in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

- Interest in social media marketing, content marketing, sales, and startup growth .

- Familiarity with Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Canva, CapCut, or similar tools.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Creative, organised, proactive, and comfortable working remotely.

- Basic video editing, graphic design, SEO, or email marketing skills are a plus.

Benefits

What we offer 

- Practical experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, sales, and SaaS customer acquisition .

- Direct collaboration with startup founders and creative teams.

- Opportunity to run real campaigns and see measurable results.

- Exposure to AI, EdTech, children's publishing, and early-stage startup operations.

Interested? Apply with your CV and, if available, examples of social media content, marketing projects, or creative work.

title: Customer & Product Manager (CPM) (m/f/d)
description:
About BMZ Battery Solutions GmbH

The BMZ Group specialises in innovative, bespoke battery systems and energy storage solutions. Drawing on our technological expertise, international collaboration and a clear focus on our customers, we develop high-performance, cost-effective and sustainable solutions for the energy supply of tomorrow.

What sets us apart? We take responsibility, think entrepreneurially and are constantly evolving.

As Customer & Product Manager (CPM) (m/f/d) , you will be the key internal liaison between Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Quality and Production. You will coordinate our products and projects throughout the entire product life cycle, reconcile technical and commercial requirements, and ensure that customer requirements are translated into successful solutions through collaborative effort.

Your responsibilities

- Centralised internal coordination of bespoke products and projects throughout the entire product life cycle – from requirements definition through development and industrialisation to series production support

- Coordination and management of internal interfaces between Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Production and other relevant departments

- Ensuring the cross-departmental implementation of customer requirements, taking into account technical feasibility, cost-effectiveness, quality and adherence to deadlines

- Supporting development processes, product changes, industrialisation and the start of series production, as well as tracking agreed measures

- Early identification and assessment of technical, economic and organisational risks, and coordination of appropriate countermeasures

- Transparent presentation of project and product status, decision-making requirements and relevant information for Sales, segment management and the relevant specialist departments

Your Profile 

Education & Qualifications 

- A degree in engineering or industrial engineering, or a comparable qualification

- Several years’ experience in technical project management, product management or a comparable cross-functional coordination role

- A broad technical understanding of industrial products, ideally battery systems, including development, electronics, quality and manufacturing processes

- In-depth knowledge of industrial product life cycles, as well as the technical and economic interrelationships between development, industrialisation and series production

Personality & Methodological Skills 

- Customer Focus: The ability to understand customer requirements conveyed by the sales team and to consistently align their internal implementation with the best possible customer solution

- Ownership & Responsibility: A strong sense of responsibility, an entrepreneurial mindset and consistent follow-up on cross-functional tasks and results

- Trust & Teamwork: Strong communication, facilitation and coordination skills to bring different specialist departments together constructively

- Performance & Execution: A structured, analytical and solution-oriented approach to work, with strong implementation skills and the ability to confidently manage complex technical and organisational interfaces

Your benefits

You will have access to career training, mentoring sessions, and flexible working hours. We provide a company pension plan, private pension options, a company car, a company cellphone, and a company laptop. Additional perks include employee discounts, free parking, and the option to bring pets to the workplace, along with 28 vacation days per year.

Your first months at BMZ Battery Solutions GmbH

From day one, you will coordinate internal teams to turn customer requirements into successful battery solutions. Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Quality and Production, you will ensure smooth collaboration throughout the product lifecycle. If you combine technical understanding, ownership and a strong customer focus, we encourage you to apply.

title: Customer Operations Manager Kontoeröffnung (m/w/d)
description:
Eine Hausverwaltung sagt Ja zu Getmomo. Ab da bist du dran: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus der Zusage ein laufendes Konto wird. Du sammelst die nötigen Unterlagen, bereitest sie für unsere Partnerbanken auf, hältst den Kontakt zu allen Beteiligten und bleibst dran, bis alles startklar ist. Und weil du diesen Weg jeden Tag gehst, siehst du zuerst, wo er schneller werden kann.

Auf einen Blick 

- Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 40 Stunden pro Woche

- 42.000 bis 48.000 € brutto im Jahr

- Hybrid: 4 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg

- Start: ab sofort

Das machst du bei uns 

- Kontoeröffnungen bis zum Ende bringen: Du übernimmst Hausverwaltungen nach der Zusage und begleitest jede Kontoeröffnung, bis alles startklar ist.

- Unterlagen zusammenstellen: Du sammelst die Unterlagen, die unsere Partnerbanken für eine Kontoeröffnung brauchen, prüfst sie auf Vollständigkeit und leitest sie an die Bank weiter. Fehlt etwas, holst du es beim Kunden ein.

- Eng mit unseren Partnerbanken zusammenarbeiten: Du bist die tägliche Ansprechperson für unsere Partnerbanken, reichst Fälle ein, klärst Rückfragen gemeinsam und behältst im Blick, dass jeder Fall zügig weiterläuft.

- Hausverwaltungen durch den Prozess führen: Du erklärst, was als Nächstes kommt, bleibst freundlich und hartnäckig dran, auch wenn bei der Verwaltung gerade anderes brennt, und achtest darauf, dass alle den vereinbarten Weg gehen.

- Anliegen im Bestand: Auch wenn sich bei bestehenden Kunden etwas ändert, das die Bank betrifft, etwa neue Verfügungsberechtigte, läuft das über dich.

- Den Prozess besser machen: Jede Rückfrage ist ein Hinweis, was wir beim nächsten Mal vorher klären können. Du baust daraus mit dem Team Prüfregeln, Vorlagen und Automatisierungen, mit Salesforce, einem eigenen AI-nativen ERP, Slack und KI-Assistenten, die bei uns zum Alltag gehören.

Woran du deinen Erfolg merkst 

- Aus Zusagen werden schneller startklare Kunden.

- Rückfragen werden seltener, weil Unterlagen beim ersten Mal vollständig sind.

- Kein Fall geht unter, weder bei uns, noch beim Kunden, noch bei der Bank.

Das bringst du mit 

- Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung, zum Beispiel in BWL, Wirtschaftsrecht, bei einer Bank oder in der Immobilienwirtschaft. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen.

- Erste Berufserfahrung mit Kunden, egal ob aus Bank, Hausverwaltung, Kundenservice, Vertrieb oder Operations. Bankprodukte und die Abläufe einer Kontoeröffnung bringen wir dir bei.

- Du bleibst dran: Auch beim dritten Nachfassen bist du freundlich, klar und verbindlich.

- Du arbeitest genau. Ein fehlendes Dokument fällt dir auf, bevor es jemand anderes merkt.

- Du behältst bei vielen offenen Fällen gleichzeitig den Überblick und weißt bei jedem, wer gerade am Zug ist.

- Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools und schaffst wiederkehrende Handarbeit mit KI und Automatisierung ab.

- Perfektes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wie du arbeitest, ist uns wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Das bekommst du bei uns 

- Einen echten Einblick, wie Banking von innen funktioniert: Kontoeröffnung, Zahlungsverkehr, Zusammenarbeit mit Banken.

- Eigene Fälle und eigene Verbesserungsprojekte ab dem ersten Monat.

- Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung durch das Kontoeröffnungsteam, Mentoring und regelmäßiges Feedback.

- Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Büro an der Oranienstraße in Kreuzberg, hybrides Arbeiten, Firmenlaptop, kostenlose Getränke und Team-Events.

Das klingt nach dir?

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Join GLS/NXT as a Technical Support Engineer and help keep the future of out-of-home delivery running smoothly. We’re building the OOH Platform - a smart parcel locker platform that connects carriers, locker providers, and end customers across Europe.

As a Technical Support Engineer, you make sure every incident is thoroughly investigated and resolved. You handle incoming tickets, analyze logs and data to find the source of a failure, and follow each case through until it’s fully fixed. When an error keeps coming back, you push until its root cause is found and eliminated - and you build the processes, metrics, and reporting that make support predictable and transparent.

If you enjoy digging into complex problems, take ownership until things are truly fixed, and thrive in a collaborative and fast-moving environment, we’d love to have you on board. Let’s build the future of logistics - together.

Tasks

- Own incoming support tickets from triage to resolution, prioritizing by business impact.

- Analyze logs (e.g. Datadog) and production data (SQL) to find where an issue originates.

- Escalate confirmed bugs to the right team with clear, reproducible reports.

- Act as a technical point of contact for external partners on incidents and integration issues, requesting missing details and following up until each issue is properly resolved.

- Identify recurring cases and drive them to a root-cause fix instead of closing each ticket as a one-off.

- Build deep knowledge of the parcel lifecycle (drop-off, collection, returns, labelless flows, state transitions) and of how carrier and provider integrations behave, including edge cases.

- Build and improve support processes, including triage rules, escalation paths, and follow-up routines.

- Define and track support metrics such as ticket volume, resolution time, recurring issues, and response quality, and prepare regular reports on open issues and trends to push for long-term fixes.

Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in technical support , application support, or a similar engineering-facing role.

- Hands-on experience analyzing logs and working with monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog).

- Basic SQL skills for investigating production data.

- Understanding of REST APIs and integrations , with the ability to read request and response payloads.

- Experience with Postman or similar API tools.

- Experience with ticketing and issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Zendesk).

- Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to troubleshooting.

- Persistence and ownership in driving issues to resolution.

- Experience using metrics and reports to drive process decisions.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills in English , with the ability to explain technical issues to partners and internal teams.

- Nice to have: a background in logistics, parcel delivery, or e-commerce, and experience managing third-party vendors or carrier integrations.

Benefits

- Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow

- Flexible work conditions: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy

- Focus on learning: A personal budget (1.000€) for learning and development initiatives

- Physical space for ideas: A great office space in Berlin Mitte with top-tier equipment

- Transparent and competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.

- Active participation: A clear bonus system enabling participation in your and the team’s performance

- Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites

- Vacation policy: 30 days of yearly holiday

- Reward system: Rewards for the recommendation of additional team members

About GLS/NXT 

GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistic experiences driven by technology - core, adjacent & beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the Logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. We are located between Corporate and Startups and leverage the benefits from both (startup speed and corporate muscle). GLS/NXT inhabits different project teams, acting as startups with business responsibility and setting their own vision and mission. GLS/NXT is part of the GLS IT Services GmbH.

Commitment to Diversity

title: Founder's Associate
description:
Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder , weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche . Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden . Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. 

Tasks

In dieser Rolle baust du die Maschine, während wir sie skalieren . Du sitzt im Zentrum der Firma, bekommst direkten Zugang zu Produkt, Kunden und Foundern – und trägst ab Tag eins echte Verantwortung.

🧱 Operational Backbone (≈ 1/3) 

Du sorgst dafür, dass die Firma rund läuft und sauber mitwächst:

- Hiring – Du unterstützt den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenanzeigen, Sourcing, Pipeline-Pflege, Terminkoordination und Kandidaten-Kommunikation.

- Operations – Du hältst unsere internen Abläufe, Tools und Dokumentation in Ordnung und schließt die Lücken, die im Alltag auffallen.

- Datenschutz & Compliance – Du unterstützt bei Datenschutzthemen: Kundenanfragen und Fragebögen vorbereiten, Dokumente und Verzeichnisse aktuell halten, Fristen im Blick behalten.

- Produkt-Setups – Du richtest neue Kundenprojekte im Produkt ein, bereitest Projektdaten auf und stellst sicher, dass alles startklar ist.

- AI-Setup der Company – Du hilfst, unsere internen KI-Workflows aufzubauen und zu pflegen, damit jedes Team mit den besten Tools und Automatisierungen arbeitet.

🚤 Speedboats (≈ 2/3) 

Du übernimmst schnelle, eigenständige Projekte, die direkt auf Wachstum einzahlen – zum Beispiel:

- Interne Prozesse mit Notion, Zapier oder n8n automatisieren

- Go-to-Market-Experimente aufsetzen und neue Kundensegmente testen

- Kunden-Discovery vorbereiten und Erkenntnisse verdichten

- Bei Pricing-Fragen und strategischen Analysen zuarbeiten

Diese Rolle passt zu jemandem, der unternehmerisch denkt, mit Unsicherheit gut umgehen kann und eine Firma an der Schnittstelle von KI und echter Welt mitbauen will.

Requirements

Rahmen 

- Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in oder absolvierst ein Pflicht-/freiwilliges Praktikum – idealerweise für mindestens 4–6 Monate , Vollzeit

- Standort München oder Bereitschaft, für die Dauer des Praktikums von hier aus zu arbeiten

- Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

Wie du arbeitest 

- Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo.

- Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht die einzelne Aufgabe, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu machen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht — und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn auch die nächste Person versteht.

- AI-Fanatiker: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst schon Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Zapier, Lovable, Claude Code o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle und Tools aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine Meinung dazu, was taugt.

- Struktur im Chaos: Du schaffst Klarheit in unübersichtlichen Situationen – ob durch eine saubere Notion-Seite, einen organisierten Hiring-Funnel oder ein aufgeräumtes Produkt-Setup.

- Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Themen: Datenschutz und Dokumentation sind für dich kein lästiges Beiwerk – du arbeitest hier genau und zuverlässig.

Persönlicher Hintergrund 

- DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

- Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar

- Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet 

- Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden

Pluspunkte 

- Du hast bereits erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt – Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, eigenes Projekt oder eine studentische Initiative

- Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

- Du hast bereits selbst KI-Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (z. B. mit Lovable, n8n, Zapier)

- Du hast schon in einem schnell wachsenden Startup gearbeitet

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve. 

Warum alago?

Die meisten Praktika sind Zuarbeit. Dieses hier ist eine Abkürzung : Du sitzt sechs Monate im Maschinenraum eines Startups, das gerade von elf auf dreißig Leute wächst — und nimmst mit, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.

Was du danach kannst 

- Du hast ein Hiring von A bis Z begleitet und weißt, wie man gute Leute findet, bewertet und gewinnt.

- Du hast interne Systeme selbst gebaut – Automatisierungen, KI-Workflows, Prozesse – und nicht nur bedient.

- Du hast gesehen, wie ein Produkt bei echten Kunden ankommt, was es kostet und warum Deals gewonnen oder verloren werden.

- Du kannst erklären, wie eine Firma von innen funktioniert: Finanzen, Recht, Datenschutz, Produkt, Vertrieb – keine Blackbox mehr.

Du baust Glaubwürdigkeit auf, bevor deine Kommiliton:innen anfangen 

Am Ende hast du keine Liste von Aufgaben im Lebenslauf, sondern Ergebnisse mit deinem Namen dran : Prozesse, die laufen, Leute, die du mit eingestellt hast, Automatisierungen, die noch nach dir funktionieren. Genau das ist die Währung, mit der du danach verhandelst.

Zwei Türen, die danach offen stehen 

- Eigene Gründung – Du hast aus nächster Nähe gesehen, wie man eine Firma baut: Fundraising, erste Kunden, erste Hires, die Fehler inklusive. Du startest nicht bei null, sondern mit einem inneren Playbook — und mit Zugang zu den Foundern, Coaches und VCs, die dir das ehrlich spiegeln.

- Der Startup-Job, den man nicht ausgeschrieben bekommt – Wer bei uns liefert, bekommt eine echte Referenz und Türen ins Münchner Startup-Ökosystem geöffnet. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, reden wir am Ende über eine feste Rolle bei alago.

Wie du dabei wächst 

- Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) — kein Zwischenlayer, kein Praktikanten-Sonderprogramm.

- Feedback in kurzen Zyklen: Du bekommst gesagt, was gut läuft und was nicht — wöchentlich, nicht zum Abschlussgespräch.

- Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen sowie wöchentlichen Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions.

- Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst.

Wir bauen für Skalierung – aber gerade ist es noch früh. Das bedeutet viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, die am besten zu deinen Stärken passt – ob Operations, Product, Growth oder eines Tages die eigene Gründung .

- Read This Before Joining as Employee 1 to 20 at a Startup von Stacy La (Employee #3 bei Clover Health): https://review.firstround.com/read-this-before-joining-as-employee-1-to-20-at-a-startup

- First Startup Employees – Erfahrungsberichte von frühen Mitarbeitenden bei Wise, GoCardless, Gousto und mehr: https://sifted.eu/articles/first-startup-employees/

Zusätzlich bieten wir: 

- Perks: Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, zweimal pro Woche gemeinsames Team-Dinner sowie Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess.

- Standort WERK1: Arbeiten in einem der aktivsten Innovations- und Startup-Hubs Münchens mit direktem Zugang zur Startup-Community.

- Vergütung: Faire Praktikumsvergütung.

Closing

1. Schick uns deine Bewerbung 

Neben deinem Lebenslauf freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen oder anderen weitergeholfen hast.

2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten) 

Ein kurzes Kennenlernen mit Maria, um deinen Hintergrund und deine Motivation zu verstehen. Wir erklären dir die Rolle, zeigen das Produkt und beantworten erste Fragen.

3. Gespräch mit den Gründern (25 Minuten) 

Lerne Janick oder Ann-Christin kennen, mit denen du jeden Tag zusammenarbeiten wirst. Vorab bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe, die du im Gespräch kurz vorstellst. Perfekt muss sie nicht sein. Uns interessiert vor allem, wie du an Dinge herangehst.

4. Case Study / Schnuppertag (halber Tag vor Ort) 

Besuche uns in München und arbeite mit uns an einer realistischen Aufgabe – z. B. einen Hiring-Funnel strukturieren, ein Produkt-Setup vorbereiten oder eine interne Automatisierung entwerfen. So bekommst du ein echtes Gefühl für die Arbeit, und wir sehen, wie du denkst und kommunizierst.

5. Entscheidung 

Du erhältst innerhalb von 24 Stunden Rückmeldung. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉

💡 Bewirb dich direkt hier über „Jetzt bewerben“ mit deinem Lebenslauf und deiner Story.

title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops. 

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day .

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.

As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. 

Who We Want 

Hungry learner
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.

Structured self-starter
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.

Analytical thinker
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.

Customer-curious
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.

Clear communicator
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.

Scrappy generalist
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".

AI-native
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.

Has taste
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".

Language
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.

Who We Don't Want 

- You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks

- You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive

- You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience

- You get defensive when receiving feedback

- You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

Your Day to Day 

Strategic Projects (~25%) 

- Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now

- Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%) 

- Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content

- Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marketing

- Build sharp slides and reports for customers and leadership 

Customer Research (~20%) 

- Run customer interviews and turn what you hear into clear insights for the product team

- Feed those insights into roadmap decisions together with our PMs

Product Analytics & Adoption (~20%) 

- Own dashboards on activation and adoption and turn the numbers into actions

- Drive initiatives that improve activation and adoption of key features

Stakeholders 

Product Managers: Feed customer insights and data into roadmap decisions and support with research, specs and launch prep
Engineering & Design: Clarify requirements, gather product feedback and coordinate release timing for launches
Customer Success: Identify customers for interviews and work together on onboarding, activation and adoption initiatives
Sales: Build enablement material and slides, and align on positioning and messaging for new features
Marketing: Co-own product launches, webinars, release content and campaigns
Customers: Run interviews and webinars, collect feedback and turn it into insights for the team

Why People Choose Us 

- We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.

- We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.

- We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.

- We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.

- We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture 

- Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.

- Regular company-wide and team events.

- An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.

- An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.

- A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company. 

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you! 

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy. 

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂

title: Solutions Engineer - Life Sciences - EMEA
description:
This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week. 

About TULIP 

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D , at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. 

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP 

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP’s headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. 

About You: 

You've seen the challenges of day-to-day manufacturing operations firsthand — the inefficiencies, the untapped potential, and everything in between. You believe technology should make people's jobs better, not harder, and you're energized by the challenge of making that happen. You're humble, curious, and just as comfortable presenting to a C-suite executive as you are walking a production line. You thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership of what you build, and genuinely care about the customers you work with.

What skills do I need? 

- 5+ years of experience in manufacturing, operations technology, or a related field, with demonstrated customer-facing project leadership

- Experienced in Operations Technology, including MES, ERP, or similar systems; architecting and implementation experience within the Life Sciences industry, specifically in pharmaceuticals 

- Experienced in system and device integration in the manufacturing industry

- Proven track record leading Lean Manufacturing or continuous improvement initiatives; ability to walk a shop floor and identify opportunities

- Strong project management, organization, and communication skills: written and verbal, with experience managing enterprise-level engagements

- 25% travel expected within Europe 

- BS in Engineering or similar field

- Fluency in English

Key Responsibilities: 

- Partner with customers to deeply understand their operational challenges, goals, and success criteria - supporting solution architecture for their specific processes

- Work side-by-side with customers and partners to develop, configure, and implement Tulip solutions

- Support delivery of enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff through delivery, ensuring on-time, high-quality outcomes

- Build and maintain trusted relationships across customer organizations, from the shop floor to the C-suite

- Provide ongoing technical support to customers, diagnosing issues and driving resolution with urgency and care

- Leverage knowledge of OT/IT systems (MES, ERP, device integration) to guide customers through complex implementation decisions

- Serve as a consistent voice of the customer internally — surfacing insights, patterns, and feedback to Product and Engineering teams

- Contribute to the development and improvement of internal processes, playbooks, and delivery frameworks

Working At Tulip 

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don’t match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. 

We’re building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

- Direct impact on product and culture

- Flexible work schedule

- Virtual company events and happy hours

- In-office catered lunches and stocked kitchens

We are an equal-opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Please note that we may use AI-based tools to support parts of our hiring process. All data processing is carried out in compliance with local data protection laws, ensuring all personal candidate information is handled securely and ethically.

flaconi setzt sich als Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit ein und begrüßt und ermutigt alle qualifizierten Bewerbern mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund und Identität, unabhängig von ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Geschlechtsidentität, Migrationshintergrund, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderungsstatus, sexueller Orientierung, Religion oder Alter, sich zu bewerben.

- Du bringst nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Teamleitung oder im Salonmanagement mit.

- Du besitzt starke Kommunikations-, Mentoring- und Organisationsfähigkeiten.

- Du brennst für Beauty, Trends und eine außergewöhnliche Customer Experience.

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

- Du hast eine proaktive Hands-on-Mentalität, ein Gespür für Stil und Liebe zum Detail.

- flaconi Academy: Mit unseren internen und externen Weiterbildungsangeboten kannst du deinen eigenen Karriereweg aktiv gestalten.

Our Mission 
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture 
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role 
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d) , you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities 

- Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

- Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

- Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

- Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications 

- You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

- You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

- You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

- You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

- You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

- You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

- You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

- You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

- Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

- Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

- Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

- Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

description:

RadCentre ist ein etablierter Anbieter von Softwarelösungen für die medizinische Bildgebung und Radiologie. title: Principal Software Engineer - Storage
description:
What You'll Do 

As a Principal Software Engineer - Storage, you will help set the technical direction for Radiant's cloud storage offering and lead the design and delivery of the storage services and data capabilities required to run demanding cloud and AI workloads at scale.

You'll work across object, block, and file storage, data lifecycle, performance, resilience, APIs, and platform integrations. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, and security teams, and with customers running the most demanding storage workloads.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on building storage services that are high-performance, reliable, scalable, and easy to consume, through architecture, code, and the standards other teams build on.

Key Responsibilities 

- Set the technical vision and architecture for Radiant's storage services, and lead their design and implementation.

- Design and build storage systems across object, block, and file, including the control plane, the data plane, and integration with existing Radiant services.

- Translate product and customer requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with the Storage Product Manager.

- Own the performance, durability, availability, and consistency characteristics of the storage platform, and define the service levels it can credibly meet.

- Profile, benchmark, and tune throughput, latency, and IOPS for AI training, inference, and other data-intensive workloads.

- Lead integration of storage with compute, Kubernetes (CSI), networking, IAM, observability, and developer tooling.

- Design for failure through replication, snapshots, data protection, failure recovery, and safe upgrades at scale.

- Drive operational excellence with SRE, including capacity planning, observability, incident response, and post-incident improvements.

- Raise the engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, design and code review, and technical standards.

Your Profile 

- Extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed storage systems or storage-heavy cloud infrastructure.

- A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

- Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

- Deep technical expertise across:

- Storage: object, block, and file storage, snapshots, replication, erasure coding, caching, tiering, data lifecycle

- Protocols & interfaces: S3, NFS, SMB, CSI, NVMe/NVMe-oF, RDMA, POSIX semantics, storage APIs

- Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, high-performance networking, GPU clusters, cloud platforms

- Reliability: durability, availability, consistency models, consensus, failure recovery, data integrity

- Observability & security: metrics, logging, tracing, IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, auditability

- Hands-on experience with technologies such as WEKA, VAST, DDN, Lustre, Ceph, MinIO, Pure Storage, or similar.

- Understanding of AI and HPC storage patterns, such as large-scale training data pipelines, checkpointing, and high-throughput parallel file systems.

- Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, durability, availability, cost, and operational complexity.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Comfortable working directly with customers on highly technical problems.

What You Bring 

- Storage domain expertise: Understand how storage architecture affects application and workload performance, down to the hardware.

- Engineering excellence: Write and review code that sets the standard for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

- Architectural judgement: Make sound long-term decisions on systems where data loss is not an option.

- Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

- Systems thinking: Understand how storage interacts with compute, networking, and the rest of the cloud platform.

- Ownership: Drive storage capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

Qualities we look for: 

- Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

- Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

- You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us? 

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

- 25 days of annual leave

- A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

- Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

- Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

- Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

- Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

- Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

- Participation in the company shares program

- Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Principal Engineers) → Whiteboard Session → Final. 

Company Overview: 

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

description:
About Radiant 

Radiant builds and operates AI-native cloud platforms for high-performance GPU workloads. Our infrastructure brings together data centres, compute, networking, storage and software to serve customers with demanding AI requirements.

As we grow internationally, we are establishing Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in several regions. These centres will provide specialist capability and operational support to teams across Radiant. We need a clear model for how each centre is launched, managed and connected to the wider business.

About the role 

The Global Capability Centre UK Lead will help design, launch and scale Radiant’s GCCs. You will work closely with local GCC leaders and UK teams across People, Legal, Finance, IT, Security and Operations.

Your job is to make sure each centre has a defined purpose, an effective team structure, practical ways of working and the support it needs to deliver. You will also act as a point of contact and advocate for GCC leaders in the UK, helping resolve issues that span multiple teams or locations.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional role. You will help shape the overall model while also dealing with the details that determine whether a new centre works well from day one.

What you’ll do: 

Plan and launch GCCs 

- Help assess potential locations based on talent availability, cost, time zones, regulation and operational needs.

- Define the remit of each centre with local and UK leaders. Clarify which work belongs in the GCC, which stays with existing teams and how responsibilities may change as the centre grows.

- Support launch plans, including the order in which centres and functions are established, key decisions, dependencies and transition milestones.

- Coordinate with Legal, Finance, People and Security on entity setup, employment arrangements, data residency and other local requirements.

Build teams and operating models 

- Work with GCC leaders to design team structures, reporting lines and management layers that suit each stage of growth.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition on headcount plans, hiring priorities and the skills needed to deliver each centre’s remit.

- Align roles and career paths with Radiant’s global framework. Help local leaders plan for retention, succession and leadership development.

- Define ownership, handoffs and escalation routes between GCCs and UK functions so work moves smoothly across teams and time zones.

- Establish consistent core processes while adapting them where local law, customer requirements or operating conditions call for it.
