title: Data Center Architect
description:
Role Profile 

Job Title: Data Centre Architect 

Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development 

Location: UK hybrid 

Company Overview: 

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.

This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.

What You’ll Do 

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities 

Technical negotiation with colocation providers 

- Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

- Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.

- Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.

Specification & SOW 

- Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.

- Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.

- Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

- Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance 

- Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

- Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

- Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

- Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards 

- Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

- Track the roadmap: higher rack densities, 800 VDC distribution, new cooling classes and optics, and tell the business early what it means for sites already contracted.

Deliverables You Own: 

- Site technical assessment: Scored, evidence-based report per candidate site, comparable across providers, with risks and mitigations.

- Technical schedules to the colocation agreement: Measurable commitments, tested in acceptance, with remedies agreed by legal.

- Cluster white-space SOW: Complete enough that a contractor can price and build without asking us questions; traceable to OEM requirements.

- Reference designs and layouts: Rack, row and POD layouts, power and cooling single-line and P&ID level interfaces, fibre pathways and densities.

- Acceptance test plan and evidence pack: Pass and fail criteria set before work starts; signed results per gate.

- Requirements baseline and change log: One current version of the truth, with every variation recorded and costed.

- Risk and issues register: Technical risks to schedule and capacity, with owners and dates.

Working Relationships: 

- Cluster and network architects: You translate their cluster design into facility requirements, and they rely on you to say what a site can and cannot carry.

- OEMs, mainly NVIDIA: You are the facility-side counterpart; you obtain, interpret and challenge site-requirement documents.

- Colocation providers: Day-to-day technical counterpart through negotiation, build and acceptance.

- Procurement, legal and finance: You provide the technical substance of commercial terms and the impact of variations.

- Site operations and deployment teams: You hand over a clean specification and acceptance evidence, and take back lessons learned.

What You Bring: 

- 8 or more years in data centre design, delivery or technical consulting, including at least 3 years on high-density (50 kW per rack or more) or liquid-cooled deployments.

- Direct experience writing or reviewing technical specifications and SOWs for white-space fitout, and managing contractors against them to acceptance.

- Strong working knowledge of data centre power: MV and LV distribution, UPS and generator topologies, redundancy models (N+1, 2N, distributed), busway and rack power, metering and power quality.

- Strong working knowledge of cooling: direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility and technology loops, warm-water and dry-cooler designs, fluid quality and flushing, leak detection and containment.

- Working knowledge of structured cabling and pathways for large GPU fabrics (single-mode optics, high fibre counts, InfiniBand and Ethernet physical layers), and of rack and POD layouts.

- Familiarity with NVIDIA rack-scale platforms (GB200 or GB300 class, or later) and their facility requirements, and the ability to read OEM site-requirement documents critically.

- Proven ability to run technical negotiations with colocation or construction counterparties, and to explain trade-offs to commercial, legal and executive audiences.

- Command of standards such as EN 50600 and the Uptime Tier framework, ASHRAE TC 9.9 liquid-cooling guidance, and commissioning practice (levels 1 to 5).

- Excellent written communication: you produce clear, unambiguous contract-grade documents.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have): 

- Experience at a hyperscaler, neocloud or colocation provider on the operator or customer side.

- Experience with 800 VDC or other DC distribution, large battery storage, or power smoothing for AI load swings.

- Chartered engineer status or equivalent; recognised data centre credentials (for example CDCP, CDFOM, Uptime ATD or AOS).

- Familiarity with BIM, digital-twin tools and requirements-management tools.

- Willingness to travel up to 30% to sites in the UK, Europe and the US.

Success Measures: 

- First 90 days: Audit current colocation contracts and SOWs and list technical gaps; publish a requirements baseline for the current NVIDIA platform; take over technical lead on one live negotiation; agree the site-scoring framework with the cluster architects.

- 6 months: One complete SOW issued and priced with no material scope disputes; acceptance plan agreed with the provider before build starts; reusable SOW template adopted by the team.

- 12 months: Every new site contracted on the template with traceable requirements; clusters accepted on schedule with no facility-caused performance issues; fewer late variations and a measurable cut in time from site shortlist to signed technical schedule.

Qualities we look for: 

- Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up.

- Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change.

- You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

- Get stuck in: You’d rather be building than overseeing. Our strategy will keep evolving, and so will you — attitude and adaptability matter more to us than a fixed playbook or a big team behind you.

Package & Process: 

- Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

- Travel: Up to 30%.

- Interview process: 

Talent Screening > Hiring Manager Screen > Technical Interview > Final with the Head of Data Centre Development.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

The Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by empowering operators to take control of their guest relationships. We’re a passionate, high-performing group of go-getters who act as trusted advisors to restaurants and hospitality groups around the world. We take a consultative approach to sales—identifying business gaps, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping operators reduce reliance on third-party networks. We believe in the power of hospitality, and we’re proud to partner with businesses to streamline operations and deliver magical guest experiences every day.

About the Role 

As an Account Executive, you’ll work directly with restaurants and hospitality groups to understand their business needs and recommend the best-fit SevenRooms solutions—from reservations and table management to online ordering and marketing automation. You’ll drive new business by adding operators to the platform and working closely with our onboarding and account teams to ensure a smooth and enthusiastic transition. This role plays a key part in helping hospitality operators thrive, combining strategic thinking, relationship-building, and product knowledge to deliver real impact.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… 

- Build and Manage a Sales Pipeline . Identify and engage prospective restaurants and hospitality groups to grow your book of business.

- Showcase the Platform. Present the value of SevenRooms through compelling demos and conversations that help operators understand how we can support their success.

- Lead Sales from Start to Finish. Own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pitching to negotiation, contracting, and go-live support.

- Deliver Live Product Demos. Conduct live, engaging product walkthroughs both virtually and in person when needed.

- Be a Trusted Partner. Build strong relationships with prospects and clients, always advocating for their success and acting as a true advisor throughout the process.

We’re excited about you because… 

- You have 3+ years of experience in hospitality technology sales

- You’re confident presenting to clients both in person and virtually

- You’re self-driven and comfortable working independently, whether in the office or remotely

- You’re tech-savvy and quick to pick up new tools and platforms

- You’re results-oriented and bring energy and focus to your daily work

- You’ve worked with tools like Salesforce, Outreach, or similar systems

- You have a background in hospitality or restaurants (a big plus!)

- You’re open to occasional travel into key markets to connect with clients face-to-face

- You speak fluent French 

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024.

The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey 

About SevenRooms 

In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.

With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.

In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.

As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.

description:

At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.

Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to be curious, have courage, and commit fully .

Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.

About the role 

Everway is building a modern data capability to help teams make better decisions across the business. As a Data Analyst, you'll work with colleagues across Information Systems and other functions to transform data into meaningful insight that supports operational, commercial and product decisions.

You'll be part of our Data Team, helping maintain high-quality data, developing reporting, and identifying trends that enable the business to act with confidence. 

Main Responsibilities 

In this role, you will:

- Collect, clean and analyse data from a variety of sources.

- Help maintain data quality, accuracy and consistency.

- Develop and maintain data models, dashboards and reports.

- Work with stakeholders to understand data requirements and business questions.

- Analyse trends and patterns to generate actionable insights.

- Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Support data-driven initiatives across the business.

- Contribute to the design and implementation of data-driven solutions.

- Keep up to date with developments in data analysis tools and best practice.

Essential Criteria 

- Degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, computer science or software engineering.

- 2+ years' experience in a Data Analyst or similar role.

- Proficiency with SQL, Excel and at least one analytical programming language such as Python or R.

- Understanding of data modelling and statistical analysis.

- Experience creating dashboards and visualisations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker Studio.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and works effectively with colleagues across the business.

- Demonstrates attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, reliable data.

Desirable Criteria . 

- Experience with Databricks or similar data platforms

- Experience working in an agile environment.

- Experience within the education technology sector.

- Familiarity with Confluence or a similar documentation platform.

- Experience using AI tools to improve analysis, reporting or workflow efficiency.

title: Complaints Handler
description:
About Zego 🚀 

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor .

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. 

Purpose of the role 

Complaints are where things get real - the customer is already frustrated or in distress, the stakes are higher, and poor handling has direct regulatory consequences.

As a Complaints Handler, you'll own a caseload of customer complaints from acknowledgement through to final response. You'll investigate thoroughly, reach fair outcomes, and explain them clearly, all in line with DISP and Consumer Duty - and you'll take pride in getting it right for the customer first time.

You'll report to the Complaints Team Leader and work closely with teams across Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to get to the right answer and fix the root cause.

Case Handling 

- Own and resolve a caseload of customer complaints following initial acknowledgement

- Investigate each complaint thoroughly, analysing all the facts and related documentation

- Gather the information you need from internal teams and external partners

- Draft Final Response Letters that are clear, fair, and evidence a full investigation

- Keep customers informed throughout and manage expectations along the way

- Stay in control of your workload by actively monitoring and updating case management systems

Quality & Compliance 

- Keep complaints logged, acknowledged, and progressed within DISP timescales

- Apply Consumer Duty and vulnerable customer standards consistently across every case

- Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-risk cases to your Team Leader promptly

- Support complaints reporting to management, senior leaders, QA assessors, and Compliance

Collaboration 

- Work with Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to resolve complaints and address root causes

- Contribute to feedback sessions, process improvement discussions, and complaint trend insight

What you will need to be successful

Essential 

- Proven experience handling complaints end to end within an FCA-regulated environment, ideally motor insurance.

- Working knowledge of DISP and Consumer Duty as they apply to complaint handling.

- Clear, concise written communication, and the emotional intelligence to handle difficult conversations well.

- An analytical, organised approach - you can balance multiple priorities and deliver within SLAs.

- You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

Desirable 

- Experience of ShareDo or equivalent case management systems.

The Zego ways of working 🏡 

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like .

Benefits 🎁 

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Who we are 

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

More than 30,000 investors across 70 countries trust us with their identity documents, company records, bank details and the financial picture of their portfolios. Several of our products are regulated by the FCA, and we’re now serving institutional clients and expanding into new markets.

Our security needs to grow faster than we do. We’re looking for someone to own it.

The opportunity 

You’ll be GetGround’s first dedicated security engineer. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll decide how we prevent, detect and respond to threats across our cloud, devices, identity and SaaS estate, and then build it.

The scope goes beyond configuring tools. You’ll run our SIEM and own our alerts, keep us ahead of a threat landscape that AI is changing fast, and make sure leadership knows where we stand and what we need.

You’ll work closely with our site reliability engineer, product engineers, our Compliance team and our Data Protection Officer. Over time, you’ll be able to shape how security works across GetGround, including the standards, processes and future hires we need.

What you’ll do 

- Own our security posture. You’ll be the person accountable for security at GetGround. Assess where we are today and define a roadmap that balances security with what the business needs. Be pragmatic: understand our stage, what risk we can accept for now and what has to be fixed today. Keep leadership informed about our risks, what you need and how we’ll address them.

- Stay ahead of threats. The threat landscape is moving faster than ever, and AI is driving much of that change. AI-generated phishing, deepfake social engineering, prompt injection and data leaking through AI tools are all part of it. Track what’s emerging, judge what matters to a regulated fintech and act before it reaches us.

- Run our SIEM and own our alerts. Make sure logs from GCP, identity, endpoints, SaaS tools and our own platform reach the SIEM and stay there. Write detection rules, map coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, tune out the noise and make sure nothing important goes unnoticed.

- Automate response. Build playbooks that contain common threats as soon as an alert fires. Lead incident response when things go wrong, and make sure we learn from it.

- Protect the data we hold. Know where sensitive data lives, who can access it and when it moves. Secure every channel it passes through: devices through endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware monitoring and protection, email and cloud storage through data loss prevention, and our platform and tools through access controls. Make the secure path the easy path for everyone at GetGround.

- Work across the business. Partner with our site reliability engineer and product engineers on secure infrastructure and design, and with Compliance on our obligations. Assess vendors and run training people actually remember.

- Set our policies and back them with working controls. Build and keep updating our security policies, best practices and information security management system (ISMS). Implement and automate the technical controls behind our security certifications and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, so that passing an audit reflects how we really operate.

- 

What you bring 

- Hands-on detection and response experience. You’ve run a SIEM, built detection rules and owned alerting in production. You know what a bad log looks like.

- A habit of staying current. You follow how attackers are using AI and other new techniques. You turn what you learn into concrete defences, not headlines.

- Cloud security depth. You understand cloud infrastructure, identity and networking well enough to harden them, ideally on GCP.

- Endpoint and identity experience. You’ve run EDR, anti-malware and identity tooling across a company’s devices and SaaS estate.

- An automation-first mindset. You’d rather automate a control or a response than do it by hand, and you use AI tools to multiply your output.

- Judgement about risk. You can separate a real threat from a theoretical one, prioritise accordingly and explain the trade-off to people who aren’t specialists.

- Ownership and clear communication. You take responsibility for outcomes, surface problems early and tell leadership plainly what you need. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, an auditor or the CEO.

Bonus 

- Experience in fintech, financial services or another FCA-regulated environment.

- Experience implementing controls for security certifications such as ISO 27001.

- Experience with SOAR tooling and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform.

- Experience securing AI systems or LLM-based products.

- Experience as the first or only security hire at a startup or scale-up.

- Experience with UK GDPR or working alongside a Data Protection Officer.

- Experience with identity and zero-trust controls, such as SSO, phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access.

- Experience running penetration tests, red-team exercises or a bug bounty programme.

This role isn’t for you if 

- You want to stay in one specialism. In the same week you might write a detection rule, roll out a device policy and close a gap in our compliance controls.

- You’re comfortable with alerts nobody reads. We want fewer, better alerts, and someone who cares whether they lead to action.

- You see security as the department of no. We need someone who finds the secure way to ship, not someone who blocks the business by default.

- You want a fully defined programme to execute. We need someone who can assess what exists, set the direction and take ownership of it.

- You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.

Why join 

- Own security for a platform trusted with sensitive financial data by more than 30,000 investors.

- Build our security function from the ground up as we expand internationally.

- Work on challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, customer data, AI and regulated services.

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

- Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.

- Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

What we are building: The first end-to-end real estate investment offering - making the dream of owning real estate more accessible to everyone globally.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY .

The role 

You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team

- Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets

- Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it)

- Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought

- Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team

- Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel

What we’re looking for

We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation.

- Scar tissue : 6+ years of Product Management experience in an early-stage environment, where you’ve learned the hard way what works and what doesn’t, and built complex products and features along the way

- Evals: Comfortable with evals for agents and driving quality improvements via evals and recursive self-improvement

- Technical IQ : Comfortable with API, data pipelines, SQL, and so on. A background in product engineering is a strong plus.

- Extreme ownership : You own your area, cradle-to-grave; this is not a relay race where you only do one part and then hand off the next bit of product work to someone else

- Clever use of AI : You’re an aggressive and proficient user of AI, but you never switch off the local LLM that you were born with :)

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you

title: System Performance Intern
description:
About Pangea Propulsion: 

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. 

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a System Performance Intern in Toulouse .

About the role: 

We are seeking a motivated System Performance Intern to join our System Performance team in Toulouse. During this six-month internship, you will support system-level design, modelling and performance analysis activities for Kronos full-flow staged-combustion rocket engines.

You will work closely with System Performance engineers and specialists in combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to connect engine requirements and design choices with cycle modelling, subsystem characteristics and overall engine performance. You will be involved in the development and execution of engine models, investigating nominal, throttled and off-nominal operating conditions, and assessing how evolving subsystem designs influence the complete propulsion system. The work will include sensitivity studies, design trade-offs and support to the definition of operating and control strategies.

This internship requires strong fundamentals in thermodynamics and fluid mechanics, an understanding of liquid rocket-engine cycles, and the ability to interpret numerical results critically rather than treating simulation tools as black boxes. You will contribute to transient analyses covering start-up, throttling and shutdown, and consolidate results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes, subsystem requirements and technical documentation for design reviews.

Key Responsibilities: 

· Develop, modify and execute system-level engine models in EcosimPro/ESPSS.

· Analyse nominal operating points and engine operational envelopes, including throttled and off-nominal conditions.

· Support engine-cycle optimisation and system-level design trade-offs.

· Perform sensitivity studies on key design and operational parameters.

· Translate simulation results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes and subsystem requirements.

· Support preparation and maintenance of System Performance documentation for project design reviews.

· Work with combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to integrate evolving subsystem designs into the system model.

What you need to be successful: 

· MSc in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent, preferably with a background in propulsion, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, energy systems or numerical modelling.

· Experience with numerical modelling and engineering analysis through academic or professional projects.

· Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and heat transfer.

· Understanding of liquid rocket propulsion and the fundamental operation of rocket-engine cycles.

· Ability to analyse coupled engineering systems and critically interpret simulation results.

· Basic programming or engineering scripting capability, preferably Python and/or MATLAB.

Soft Skills: 

· Strong analytical problem-solving skills.

· Ability to communicate technical results clearly in English through documentation and presentations.

· You are expected to work in a structured and analytical manner, communicate your results clearly, and progressively take ownership of defined modelling and analysis tasks while receiving guidance from experienced engineers.

Other useful skills: 

· Experience with EcosimPro/ESPSS or another 0D/1D system-simulation environment.

· Knowledge of staged-combustion or full-flow staged-combustion rocket-engine cycles.

· Understanding of turbopumps, turbines, pre-burners, combustion chambers, regenerative cooling circuits, valves and feed systems.

· Experience with transient simulation, controls or system dynamics.

· Experience with sensitivity analysis, uncertainty propagation or Monte Carlo methods.

· Experience processing engineering data using Python or MATLAB.

· Familiarity with Git/version control and structured engineering-development processes.

· A university project, thesis or previous internship involving propulsion-system modelling.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us… 

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork : We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance : we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth : we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability : because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring : we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

description:

Join Hornetsecurity's Service Reliability (SR) team and help power cybersecurity services used by customers worldwide. Our infrastructure processes over 200 million emails and scans more than 100 million websites every day, running on 4,000+ servers and 300+ Kubernetes nodes.

This isn't just about keeping systems running. You'll take end-to-end ownership of platforms, from architecture and automation to production operations and continuous improvement.

Your Job

- Own and shape platforms: Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable infrastructure for our internal product teams, taking technical ownership from initial requirements to production.
- Drive architecture and modernization: Make key technical decisions, improve existing systems, and help teams address performance, scalability, and reliability challenges.

title: Solutions Architect, Enterprise (French Speaking)
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Solutions Architecture Team partners with our users to realize their full potential through the adoption of prescriptive solutions that drive their growth and success. We influence revenue growth across Stripe’s product portfolio, and collaborate with sales, support, product management, and Stripe’s executive team to provide the best experience to our most valued customers. 

What you’ll do

As a member of the team, the Solutions Architect will build highly consultative trusted relationships with c-level executives and technical decision makers in the customer’s organization to provide business and technical thought leadership, and become a trusted advisor in solving mission-critical business challenges. She/he will architect business models with them so they can drive new monetization opportunities and growth for both the user and Stripe. 

Responsibilities

- Be a key member of a Stripe account team with deep involvement in defining the customer strategy

- Identify and close new complex opportunities, and accelerate solution adoption. Understand and align with the customer’s product and business roadmap and uncover opportunities for Stripe to accelerate their progress on that roadmap. 

- Drive thought leadership and be a trusted advisor for key business and technical stakeholders including CIO, CTO, COO, CRO, CDO, Head of Product Engineering and Head of Payments. 

- Work to deeply understand the customer’s business objectives, and then design and apply Stripe’s solutions to their challenges. Develop and articulate the end to end customer transformation journey and create future roadmaps and architectures with deep 3rd party integrations in play.

- Conduct business analysis and background research on customers, industries, and competitors with a view to support growth for the user's business. 

- Lead strategy engagements with users to align to business priorities, design solutions and secure the technical win by performing in-depth customer discovery, evangelizing the proposed solutions through executive briefings, readouts, presentations, workshops and solution demos.

- Act as the “Voice of the Customer” to bring insights, trends and opportunities to the leadership, product and engineering teams from the forefront and prioritized for delivery. 

- Participate in sales forecasting, Quarterly Business Reviews and account/territory planning to strategically and tactically align for success

You have achieved an experienced position as an enterprise architect, senior solution architect or principal solution engineer and have a successful track record advising enterprise-grade digital native / SAAS / Platform / Marketplace companies, focused on identifying business priorities, formulating technology strategies and designing an end-to-end business solution. - Experience in the payments/ billing / invoicing / issuing / banking / Fintech space

- Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.

- Effective group-facilitation skills and confidence in proposing and leading customer meetings to gain strategic footing and pursue opportunities.

- Outstanding spoken and written communication skills, presentation skills, and confident in explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to operate independently in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment

- Passion to take on ownership and drive change in a constantly evolving environment. 

- Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

- Ability to travel per business needs

Preferred requirements

- Prior experience in consulting

- Experience at a growth stage internet/software company

title: Social Media & Influence Director H/F - CDI
description:
About WPP Media 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

À propos de WPP Media : 

WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.

Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.

Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com .

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com .

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.

Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

- Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.

- Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.

- Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.

Rôle et missions : 

Rattaché au Head of Social Media et en coordination étroite avec le Head of Strategy , vous pilotez un portefeuille de clients clés et participez activement au développement de l’agence.

Vous concevez des stratégies de contenu innovantes pour les écosystèmes de nos marques clientes en intégrant les cibles, les nouveaux usages, les plateformes sociales et les enjeux de brand experience , tant sur le volet éditorial que sur l'influence marketing.

Vos responsabilités s'articulent autour de 3 grands axes :

- Conseil Stratégique & Relation Client 

- Stratégie & Recommandations : Écriture et pilotage des recommandations stratégiques Social Media & Influence (fil rouge et temps forts) pour les marques de votre portefeuille ; définition et suivi des KPI de performance.

- Soutenance & Restitution : Présentation orale des recommandations et des bilans stratégiques auprès des annonceurs, en vous appuyant sur votre équipe et en synergie avec les pôles experts de l’agence ( Content Strategy , Production, Événementiel, Média).

- Delivery & Satisfaction : Suivi rigoureux de la relation client, garantie du bon déploiement opérationnel des campagnes, respect des plannings, gestion des budgets et rentabilité financière des projets.

- Développement Commercial & Offre 

- New Business & Croissance : Pilotage des briefs entrants (Inbizz et NewBizz) et participation active au développement du portefeuille clients et du chiffre d'affaires de la Business Unit Studio M.

- Développement de l’offre Influence : Contribution à l’enrichissement des méthodologies et outils (GOAT, outils de veille/social listening) et développement des relations avec les créateurs de contenu, agences de management et maisons artistiques.

- Management & Synergies d’Équipe 

- Management d’équipe : Encadrement, formation et montée en compétences de 1 à 3 personnes.

- Organisation & Process : Mise en place des process de collaboration pour accompagner la progression et la fidélisation des talents au sein de l'équipe.

- Transversalité : Développement des synergies au quotidien avec les autres expertises de WPP Media.

Profil recherché : 

- Expérience : De formation supérieure (Bac+5 en marketing, communication, médias ou école de commerce), vous justifiez d’au moins 6 ans d’expérience en agence (Social Media, média ou globale) sur la gestion de comptes d'envergure.

- Expertise Métier : Excellente culture des plateformes sociales, des tendances de contenu, des mécaniques d'activation d'influence et de l'écosystème des créateurs.

- Sens Stratégique & Business : Fortes capacités d'analyse, d'écriture stratégique et aisance à l'oral pour pitcher devant des directions marketing. Sensibilité financière (gestion de marge, suivi de P&L projet).

- Leadership : Expérience réussie en management ou tutorat d'équipe, esprit d’écoute, bienveillance et rigueur opérationnelle.

- Langues : Maîtrise courante de l’anglais (écrit et oral), indispensable dans notre environnement international.

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages : 

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.

Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.

Nos avantages comprennent : 

- Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.

- Congés offerts : 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.

- Ancienneté : Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.

- Santé & Équité : 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.

- Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel (CESU), et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.

- Engagement sociétal : Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act .

- Tools & Innovation : Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes, l'écoute et le reporting (WPP Open).

Process de recrutement : 

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process :

- Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement : Un premier échange téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et vos aspirations.

- Entretien Opérationnel : Un échange approfondi avec le manager du poste pour échanger sur vos expériences, la vision du pôle et les enjeux clients.

- Étude de cas : Une mise en situation concrète (cas pratique stratégique Social Media & Influence) suivie d’une restitution orale.

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.

description:
About Pangea Propulsion: 

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. 

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. 

About the role 

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

- Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
- Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
- Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.

The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities 

- Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
- Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
- Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python .
- Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
- Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
- Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
- Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
- Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
- Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.

What you need to be successful

You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if… 
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…

Key Responsibilities 

- Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

- Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

- Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

- Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

- Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

- Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

- Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

- Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

- Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

- Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. - A faster, more efficient runtime: reduce execution time and cost while scaling to more complex workloads and larger customers.

- More capable teams: build foundations and feedback loops that multiple teams use to ship and improve agents faster.

title: Bookkeeper (Boekhouder)
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy our YouTube Channel , Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like .

About the role

We're looking for a Bookkeeper to bring our day-to-day bookkeeping and month-end close in-house. You'll be our first dedicated bookkeeper, taking over from our external accounting firm and running the books for our growing group: five Dutch BVs today, plus our entities abroad.

Our transaction volume has roughly doubled this year, and 2027 is the first financial year our accounts will be audited. You'll own the reconciliations, records and close process that make our numbers reliable, working closely with our finance lead, purchasing team and external accountants. The external accountants will continue to handle annual accounts and corporate tax, with local advisors handling tax filings abroad.

This is a hands-on bookkeeping role for someone with at least three years of experience running the full cycle through month-end. Our data and processes need cleaning up. If you enjoy turning a messy administration into a tidy one, this is that job. As you settle in, there is room to take on VAT filing and monthly payroll processing.

The role is based at our Amsterdam HQ, on-site five days a week. Salary is up to €50,000 gross a year, including the 8% holiday allowance.

What you'll do

- Own daily bookkeeping. Code supplier invoices and card spend in Spendesk with the right GL account, VAT code and cost centre, and post them to the general ledger without re-keying. Keep supplier records clean and prepare payment runs. Supplier bank-detail changes are independently verified and approved; payment approval and release sit with the finance lead.

- Keep accounts reconciled. Reconcile bank accounts, keep payables and receivables current, and investigate outstanding items so every balance is supported or explained.

- Run the month-end close. Close all entities to a fixed timetable, initially by working day eight and moving towards working day five. Own accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations, collect or prepare foreign entities' figures, agree intercompany balances and reconcile group reporting to the ledgers.

- Maintain fixed assets and inventory records. Keep the fixed-asset register up to date, including capitalisation and depreciation of our robot fleet under agreed accounting policies, and reconcile inventory accounts to month-end stock values.

- Prepare Dutch VAT returns. Prepare quarterly btw returns with our external accountants reviewing, and take over filing them over time.

- Keep the books audit-ready. Maintain supporting schedules and an audit file throughout the year. Be a day-to-day contact for our external accountants and support the audit of our 2027 accounts.

- Improve how we work. Document the close, fix recurring errors and use spreadsheets, software and AI tools to reduce manual work while checking the results carefully. Depending on your experience, take on payroll processing in Loket over time, with payroll tax filings remaining with our external accountants.

What we're looking for

- Full-cycle bookkeeping experience. You have at least three years of experience running the books through month-end, at an accounting firm (accountantskantoor) or in-house.

- Hands-on Dutch VAT experience. You've prepared Dutch btw returns and can work through the supporting records.

- Strong reconciliation skills. You've handled balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments, beyond processing invoices. You investigate differences and follow them through to a resolution.

- Accuracy and ownership. You keep records organised, meet close deadlines and raise missing information or accounting questions early. You'd rather find the €12 difference than book it to suspense.

- Fluent English and professional working Dutch. English is our working language, and your manager doesn't speak Dutch. You can independently read and process Dutch invoices, tax correspondence and payroll documents.

- Comfort with systems and confidential information. You work confidently with spreadsheets, learn new accounting tools and handle financial and employee information carefully.

- Nice to have: Twinfield, Basecone or Spendesk (Exact, Odoo or similar also counts); multi-entity or multi-country bookkeeping, intercompany and consolidation; fixed-asset or inventory accounting in hardware or manufacturing; statutory audit support; Dutch payroll experience, ideally in Loket; an accounting qualification such as MBO-4/HBO, SPD or Praktijkdiploma Boekhouden; experience automating repetitive work. 

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

For open applications (where you don't see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.

If you don't meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you'd still be able to help us tackle complex challenges, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

title: Creative Director
description:
Creative Director 

Build with us 

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, with 900+ Mollies across 12+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you’re solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you’ll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact 

As Creative Director, you lead and evolve Mollie's Brand Design function. You help define and drive our global brand design vision, keeping it consistent and excellent across every channel and market. You support the creative vision and execution of our brand across every touchpoint, from campaigns and product experiences to storytelling and motion. The job is to balance craft excellence with speed and scale.

Brand Design is a core enabler of our GTM and growth. You'll build a consistent, world-class brand experience across our platforms and markets, so the businesses we serve understand and choose Mollie. Your creative will power GTM and growth across Europe. We're a European business today, and going global is on our roadmap. You'll own the evolution of our visual identity, design systems and creative principles, and act as the quality bar for all brand output, with executive backing to shape how Mollie shows up everywhere, including as we expand.

You'll lead an in-house studio of around 5 to 8 designers across brand, motion, digital and campaign, and build a culture of craft, feedback and continuous improvement. You'll partner directly with marketing leadership, product, growth and our founder to turn strategy into insight-driven creative. You'll work with Marketing Operations on workflows and tooling, and bring in AI tools to speed up ideation, production and iteration without lowering the bar. You'll also collaborate with teams like Employee Experience and Internal Events, and manage external agencies, freelancers and production partners when needed.

What you'll ship 

- A clear, evolved brand design vision, plus a refreshed visual identity and design system that markets adopt consistently.

- A high-performing, well-structured in-house studio, with the workflows, tooling and modular systems to deliver high-quality output at scale.

- Impactful end to end creative for flagship campaigns, product launches and brand moments that is on-brand, insight-driven and effective.

- AI-enabled creative workflows that measurably increase speed and output while holding the quality bar.

- Strong creative partnership with Marketing, Product, Growth and leadership, including a meaningful uplift to performance marketing creative.

- In your first 90 days: an assessment of the team, output and brand system, a defined vision and quick wins delivered.

- Within 6 to 12 months: a scaled studio operating model, the evolved identity live in market and AI workflows embedded.

What you'll bring 

- Proven experience leading and scaling in-house design teams or creative studios, including people leadership of a multidisciplinary team. You inspire, challenge and develop designers at all levels.

- A strong portfolio that shows high-quality brand, campaign and digital work, backed by proven brand craft.

- Exceptional creative judgement and taste, and a clear point of view on what "great" looks like.

- Experience building and maintaining design systems and brand frameworks that scale for consistency and self-serve.

- Operational strength in planning, prioritization, resourcing and workflow design, so quality holds at scale.

- Hands-on experience applying AI in creative workflows, including concepting, production and scaling assets.

- Strong communication and storytelling, with the ability to explain creative decisions to senior stakeholders, and fluent English.

Grow your way 

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to build a meaningful distribution channel from the ground up. As we expand across Europe, you will grow alongside the product area you own. You’ll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy 

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie 

We believe in Always Be Shipping , and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us .

title: Privacy & AI Officer
description:
Wil jij bijdragen aan een organisatie die in control is op het gebied van privacy en verantwoorde inzet van AI? En weet jij wet- en regelgeving te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en praktisch advies? Als Privacy & AI Officer help je afdelingen zorgvuldig om te gaan met persoonsgegevens en AI-risico’s tijdig te herkennen. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en rapporteert. Zo maak jij het verschil voor onze leden, collega’s en de continuïteit van Univé Zuid-Nederland! 

Wie ben jij? 

Je bent een toegankelijke professional met een passie voor privacybescherming en verantwoorde AI-governance. Je hebt een scherp oog voor risico’s en verbindt beleid, processen en praktijk op een natuurlijke manier. Met jouw analytisch vermogen en zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming help je de organisatie risico’s tijdig te herkennen en beheersen. Je schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, management en andere belanghebbenden en maakt complexe onderwerpen helder en praktisch.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

- Hbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een juridische richting.

- Diepgaande kennis van de AVG, privacywetgeving en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

- Praktische kennis van de AVG en ervaring met bijvoorbeeld DPIA’s, datalekken of privacyprocessen.

- Kennis van en interesse in AI-governance, AI-beleid, de AI Act en het beheersen van AI-risico’s.

- Ervaring met het implementeren en bewaken van beleid, regelingen en processen.

- Sterk analytisch vermogen, zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming en resultaatgerichtheid.

- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om belanghebbenden mee te nemen.

Wat ga je doen 

Als Privacy en AI Officer ondersteun je afdelingen bij het naleven van de AVG, het Univé privacybeleid en het AI-beleid. Maar pak je ook (pro-)actief zelf activiteiten op in het kader van dit aandachtsgebied. Je hebt een spilfunctie in het vroegtijdig onderkennen en beheersen van privacy- en AI-risico’s. Je adviseert je collega’s in de eerste lijn, coördineert de implementatie van beleid en zorgt voor het onderhoud en de naleving van privacy-instrumenten en processen.

Daarnaast registreer, coördineer en beheer je AI-toepassingen, AI-risico’s en relevante beheersmaatregelen. Je helpt bij AI-use cases, naleving van wet- en regelgeving en verantwoord gebruik en rapporteert hierover. Ook speel je een actieve rol in beleidsontwikkeling en advisering. Je volgt wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk. Zo help je Univé Zuid-Nederland om aantoonbaar in control te blijven. Het zwaartepunt van de functie ligt bij privacy, waarmee jij vanuit de eerste lijn waarde toevoegt in dit domein. AI speelt daarin een aanvullende rol en er is ruimte om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen, net als de organisatie dat doet. Je adviseert niet alleen: je helpt ook zelf bij de uitvoering waarbij je samenwerkt met de eerste lijn business owners. Juist die combinatie maakt deze functie afwisselend en zichtbaar waardevol voor de organisatie.

Hieronder een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

- Je helpt afdelingen bij privacy, AVG, AI-beleid en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

- Je coördineert de implementatie, naleving en doorontwikkeling van beleid en processen.

- Je registreert, coördineert Privacy- en AI-risico’s en zorgt voor opvolging en borging van de (beheers)maatregelen. 

- Je signaleert risico’s, ontwikkelingen en verbeterkansen en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke acties.

- Je werkt nauw samen met de 2e lijn Risk & Compliance

Wat wij bieden 

Een veelzijdige functie van 32 uur per week met directe lijnen naar de bestuurder, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en mogelijkheden om je professioneel te ontwikkelen. Je werkt aan onderwerpen die ertoe doen voor onze leden en collega’s, binnen een coöperatieve organisatie waarin samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen centraal staan. Daarbovenop kun je rekenen op:

- Een brutosalaris tussen de € 3.859 en € 5.358 per maand, exclusief vakantiegeld, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

- Een contract van 1 jaar met de intentie voor een vaste aanstelling.

- Een 13e maand, bedrijfsfitnessregeling, fietsregeling en een goede pensioenregeling.

- 25 vakantiedagen en 13 compensatie dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband.

- Een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke functie binnen een betrouwbare organisatie.

- Uitstekende werksfeer; plezier in je werk staat bij ons voorop.

- Aantrekkelijke kortingen op onze verzekeringsproducten en diensten.

Wie wij zijn 

Univé Zuid-Nederland is één van de acht regionale Univé’s, een coöperatie met de missie om de meest menselijke financiële dienstverlener van Nederland te zijn. Ons werkgebied bestaat uit Noord-Brabant, Limburg, Zeeland en delen van Utrecht, Gelderland en Zuid-Holland. Wij zijn verzekeraar en bemiddelaar in schade- en levensverzekeringen, voor zowel de particuliere als zakelijke markt. Daarnaast zijn wij ook erkend hypotheekadviseur. Onze belofte, persoonlijk en dichtbij, komt tot leven in onze lokale dienstverlening, samenwerkingen en sponsoring. Het mooiste van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de geschiedenis, de cultuur en de betrokkenheid. A Great Place to Work!

Na je sollicitatie

- Iedereen enthousiast? Dan plannen we een afspraak in waar ook de manager van deze vacature bij aanschuift.
